notes.title: Bug Fix Patch Note - Version 5.0.18
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e84901a9e4c2cb0fbf3f47b4222fa7a830db70ad.png"]

Hey Anglers,

It’s been a busy couple of weeks for our team, and we want to thank all of you for patiently waiting for the next Bug Fix Patch.

In this update, we’ve tackled a number of issues reported by players and spotted by our QA team, and one of the most important issues where massive fish (500+ kg) would get stuck in the final few meters and couldn’t be landed for a while. This should now be resolved!

We also heard your feedback about the challenge of landing the largest fish in the game, like Unique Black Marlin and Unique Swordfish over 500 kg, taking too long to bring in. To understand this better, we analyzed all catches of these giants within the last month, looking at the time from hook to landing.

Here’s what we found:

Around 50% of these catches take players 13–14 minutes on average.

The majority (50–99%) take 15–25 minutes on average.

Only about 1% of catches go up to 50 minutes on average and sometimes even longer  — rare cases, but they do happen.


If you find yourself struggling to land these giants within 15–25 minutes, consider working on your technique, seeking tips from experienced anglers, and making sure you’re using the best gear available. Please, also keep in mind that at the highest levels, even more powerful rods and reels become available to help you bring in these beasts faster. It’s very important , these are ocean monsters — some up to 600 kg, there must be that true big game fishing challenge!
Now, let’s dive into the rest of the fixes and improvements included in this patch:[olist]
Fixed a bug where exiting the settings triggered an “unsaved changes” message, and the ESC button became unresponsive.

Sunglasses once again reduce sun brightness as intended.

Addressed an issue when big fish would hang in the last 2-3 meters for some time before it could be landed on the catamaran.

Fixed incorrect detection when using Vertical Jigging.

Fish radars on the catamaran’s onboard monitors and the captain’s bridge now display consistent results.

Addressed an issue allowing players to pass through certain objects on the largest island in the Maldives location.

Adjusted the volume of the Bar Music in Maldives to match the music volume set in the game settings.

Bar music from the resort no longer plays far out at sea in Maldives.

The player profile now opens correctly from the local chat.

Fixed a bug where synchronous relocation via the captain’s pin during Fishing Together sessions caused the game to break for one of the players.

Resolved an issue where purchasing a license would sometimes result in the wrong license being bought.

Fixed a bug causing players to fall underwater when fast-forwarding time to the next day and declining boat rental.

Addressed disconnects occurring after fish were taken into hand.

Fixed an issue where players were teleported back to the beach when moving through bushes on the main Atoll at Maldives.

Corrected the overly bright, acidic color of plankton at 4a.m at Maldives.

Fixed an issue where the cooldown was not removed correctly when skipped using a Baitcoin.

Fixed an issue where changing a boat’s PIN caused a blinking effect.

Resolved an issue where boats and kayaks appeared upside down after being returned to their start position.

Fixed an issue where the character appeared elevated above the wooden bridge on Falcon Lake.

Fixed an issue where received Marker Buoys displayed stubs and empty buttons in the “Receive a Buoy from Friend” window.

Added email notifications for automatically approved Sponsored Competitions.

Fixed an issue where no hint was shown about boat relocation to the start position after a player changed their PIN.

Fixed an issue where Jonin 20000 SE reel thumbnails were mixed up in the shop and inventory.

Resolved an issue where the Rod Holder’s height adjuster on Chamaeleon Catamaran stopped working after teleporting with a Navigation Buoy.

Fixed an issue where the competition details window automatically opened when hovering over the first competition in the list.

Resolved an issue where feeder and sinker items were missing from templates.

Improved various graphical issues, including water reflections in pools and visual artifacts in sand at Maldives.

Other improvements and optimizations to enhance overall game performance.
[/olist]


Thank you for continuing to share your feedback and bug reports — they help us make the game better with every update. We’ll keep working to improve your experience.



Tight lines and good luck on the water!



_______________________________________________________________

Follow us on social media to stay tuned and be in touch with our lovely community:

Discord

Facebook Group

notes.title: Post-Release Fixes and Compensation
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f95dc6bb2da1e4b7acd2c0ba3121c6ec7994d69b.png"]

Hey Anglers,

Here’s a quick update on the post-release fixes.

We’re aware of some crash and freezing issues and are actively working on fixes. A new update is rolling out at this very moment to improve game stability. To avoid interruptions in your game play, we’re updating servers one by one, as many players are online. A few more updates will follow in the coming days, and we’ll keep you posted.

While it might seem like everyone is reporting issues, our data shows that most players are playing smoothly. Still, every affected player matters to us. The crashes vary in cause, and limited diagnostic info from users makes it harder to resolve quickly—but we’re on it.

We’re also considering compensation options for those who made in-game purchases during this period. First, we want to make sure the game is fully stable—then we’ll take care of compensation. Rest assured that your experience and satisfaction are our top priority. We’ll share details about compensation after the fixes are in place.

Regarding another reported issue—reeling in big fish (500+ kg) on the new map—some of you noticed that they get stuck in the last few meters. Our investigation showed that this isn’t a bug but a physics-based interaction. To land the fish, use a wider pull & reel motion, lifting the rod higher—just like you would in real life when pulling a very big fish onto the boat. That triggers the gaff animation and gets the fish onboard.

Thanks again for your patience and support. We’re working hard to make sure you can enjoy the game without disruptions—and we truly appreciate the trust you place in us. 

Tight lines!

notes.title: Bug Fix Patch Note - Version 5.014
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5d8a7c8626e7ef974aed0bca19a7c312545145f2.png"]
Dear Anglers,
Last night we urgently released a hot fix patch to address some of the most common issues that occurred after the Maldives Update. 
Here is what’s new:[olist]
Resolved an issue of players not being able to take out their rod or rod stands on the waterways

Fixed an issue when players didn’t get strikes when trying to complete the tutorial

Fixed an issue of balancing the amount of environmental objects appearing at the location depending on the player’s video settings

Resolved a bug when some words on the buttons appeared in other languages

Fixed an issue with Chamaeleon Cruiser Pack appearing incorrectly in the Store in Polish localization

Fixed an issue when some players couldn’t enter the game
[/olist]Known Issues
We also received reports about other issues that some of you experienced and we want to keep you in the loop about them:


[olist]
We know many of you experience freezes when entering the menu or trying to move items in the Inventory. The root cause of the issue was found - and it appears to be quite complex and needs a few technical updates on our side. We already started doing them, but it will still require a few days to complete this process. We are doing everything possible (and some impossible things) to fasten it.

The issue with the black screen when entering photo mode unfortunately returned - and it has another cause than it had before - it’s being actively investigated and we hope it will be fixed within the next few days.

We also know that some players had issues when catching big fish (over 500kg) and on the last 2-3 meters the gaff animation doesn’t get triggered. This is being addressed as well.

Some of you are getting an error when trying to enter the game. We found that it helped some players to update their OS to the latest version and re-install the game. If you are experiencing something similar, please try these steps and if it doesn’t resolve the issue, contact support@fishingplanet.com.

We are also investigating the nature of other crashes or freezes not related to entering the menu and inventory, thanks to everyone who reported the issues and helped our investigation.
[/olist]


If you are experiencing any of the issues listed above, please just wait for the fix that is on its way. No need to report them again, we already have enough information to prepare the fixes.



We also get many-many questions about when the Maldives map will be released on consoles and mobile platforms. Believe us, there is nothing in the world that we want more right now than to release it for all the platforms as soon as possible. But first, we need to stabilize the Steam and Epic Games versions with a few more hotfixes. Once that’s done, we’ll focus on getting the update to all other platforms. Thanks so much for your patience.


Server Reboot
Last, but not least, we want to inform you that tomorrow, June 20 at 5:05 AM UTC there will be a server reboot with an estimated downtime of 10 minutes. This is one of the things we need to do to stabilize the system after the release.



Thank you for your incredible patience, understanding, and all the fast bug reports. We truly hope you’re still enjoying your time in the Maldives — more improvements are on the way!



Tight lines!

notes.title: Release Note: Noomaa Kuda Atholhu, Maldives
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0b4ee9b74095f1b3c7855c6d679fb47cc541ca2d.png"]

Hey Anglers,



The hot season is here, and it’s the perfect time for a tropical fishing getaway! Welcome to Noomaa Kuda Atholhu — one of the most stunning and luxurious fishing destinations on the planet, now officially available in-game.



To celebrate this launch with our amazing community, we’re giving every player a special gift: the crazy-bazy Crabby Cap! Claiming it is easy—just open the game and head to the Personal Offers tab. Enjoy!



Let’s get down to what’s new!


Noomaa Kuda Atholhu, Maldives
Get ready to explore a brand-new tropical destination spanning 400 square kilometers (nearly 100,000 acres) of open ocean! This massive area features 55 fully explorable atolls, islands, and ocean spits—perfect for discovery and fishing from the shore. You’ll find 28 fish species swimming these waters, including 14 completely new additions to the game: Swordfish, Black Marlin, Sailfish, Great Barracuda, Blacktip Reef Shark, Two-Spot Red Snapper, Wahoo and many more. Fish at this location generally grow bigger and stronger, bringing a whole new layer of challenge to the fish fighting experience into the game.

Players can unlock this destination at level 94, or dive right into the adventure with one of the DLC packs, each including 30- or 60-day access, plus an Advanced License and Premium account for the same time period. The maximum level cap in the game has been increased from 90 to 100.


A brand new fishing yacht with color customization feature
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/123dd2a93ff5a3d07ace5795083adb47985e93a7.png"]

The all-new Chameleon Catamaran is your ultimate ride for big game fishing parties with room for 5 players onboard. Packing a massive 3,000 kg fish storage and a 650 kg max fish capacity, it’s ready to keep even the most Unique beasts this destination has to offer. Every angler onboard gets their own fishing spot with two adjustable rod holders and a personal display loaded with Fish Finder 360, Echo Sounder, and a GPS Map while having their rods in sight.



But what makes this yacht special is that it comes with an exclusive color customization feature. Only the bravest anglers can earn it by taking on a series of challenging missions that lead to the ultimate showdown with the biggest monster in the game… 


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd1T05KuGn4HfdNLZjmF_bXDQkSvCKQZNjHK0YEiZ6TZ6Be16EOGJiqKVaw21tgqSI_dCpd_XA8k9HibFXOc-sDjdJgKDSioQT6Fv7wqdcr-rgXTm_uK_31ARi_xQQvGVpbMrSG?key=N3866dwmsuEKyYszKXxZ7g"]

Chamaeleon Catamaran can be obtained with two heavy-duty trolling setups from high-technology Tsurihito™ fishing brand, a generous supply of lures and baits for your big game fishing, and a spacious Tackle Wagon accommodating over 300 items, you'll have all essential fishing gear at your fingertips in Chamaeleon Cruiser Pack. With 60-days of access, Advanced License and Premium account, additional Marker and Navigation Buoys we got you covered for an unforgettable escape from the mundane.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743490/Fishing_Planet_Chamaeleon_Cruiser_Pack/"][/dynamiclink]
New Bottom Spinning Gear
Another exciting addition to the game is Saltwater Bottom Spinning fishing. You get new specialized rods designed for targeting fish that dwell near the ocean floor. These rods blend the sensitivity and versatility of traditional spinning setups with the strength and durability required for deep-sea conditions. They are perfect for catching bottom-dwelling predators such as Groupers, Snappers, Amberjacks, and various reef species. These rods have a strong backbone and a sensitive tip to detect subtle bites and handle the weight of heavy fish. Paired with saltwater spinning reels offering high drag capacity and corrosion resistance, they’re built to meet the demands of bottom fishing in saltwater environments.



An ultra-powerful bottom spin setup from Tsurihito™ and an extra-long spinning set from Fletch and Bradford™ go in the Atoll Scout Pack. All kinds of baits and lures specially designed to chase exotic ocean species, and a super spacious 400+ items Tackle Wagon Vault™ to have everything you need, will make your ocean fishing smooth and easy. A tropical Angler’s outfit with polarized glasses and the AquaRay™ headlamp will fill your 30-day journey through the Maldives atolls with extra comfort.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743500/Fishing_Planet_Atoll_Scout_Pack/"][/dynamiclink] 
Vertical Jigging Retrieval
Try out a new fishing technique in the game — Vertical Jigging — where lures like pilkers, spoons, jigs, and more are dropped straight down into the depths and retrieved with sharp, jerking motions to mimic injured prey. This method draws in predatory fish from all depths — from the bottom to the midwater layers — provoking strikes through sudden lure movements.



Vertical jigging is a precise and effective way to fish, offering anglers the chance to engage fish directly below the boat in deep or open waters. To help you master the technique, the game tracks your retrievals in real-time, so you’ll know exactly when you’re doing it right.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2885023b41e2f441a9642cee6bf8d090441deee8.png"]
New Saltwater Items
Experiment with the new saltwater gear that is now available in the In-game Store. You’ll find massive Saltwater Poppers and Spoons, brand-new Triple-Hook Pilkers—perfect for targeting aggressive ocean predators. For trolling fans, there’s a full set of new gear, including Luminous Trolling Octopuses and the versatile Trolling Skirt Rig, which consists of a Trolling Skirt, Head and Hook.

 
Livebait Trolling Rig
A specialized fishing setup made for trolling live baitfish behind a moving boat. To support this method, we’ve introduced a range of new baits, including various sizes of Flying Fish, Indian Ocean Squid, and Split Tail Mullet to tempt predators like Swordfish, Tuna, Marlin, Barracuda, and more.


Missions, Competitions, Achievements, Monsters
Take on a chain of new engaging monster missions and come face-to-fin with two formidable ocean predators. This time, the Brave Angler must confront the fast and legendary Night Windrazor — a true hunter of the dark — and the terrifying Hordecuda, a one-of-a-kind monster unlike anything you've faced in the game before. 


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeahf0K5lCOUHy0NmoJp2uPUXc67Sa2SrOqI1999iC84hoAaoSRl7DA14SCRjOqIYqN-uXrE5kE_CvuDpgrLSM_bv-3qOzXrcDopZlWsJLf-A0ADshLH_tNG8-AAk5y-TJusG4U?key=N3866dwmsuEKyYszKXxZ7g"]

Dive into a challenge of 6 all-new thrilling competitions and get up close with vibrant marine life of the Maldives. Unlock 11 fresh achievements as you explore every stretch of these tropical waters — and only the most curious and relentless adventurers will earn the hidden achievement.


Sounds Improvements
 

We’ve introduced a range of sound improvements to enhance your experience. These include new drag and reeling sounds for both saltwater and freshwater reels, updated casting sounds that now vary based on distance and reel type, and refined reel opening/closing sounds. Additionally, some splashing sounds for floats, lures, and fish have been updated. New background music has also been added to the main menu.


[previewyoutube="Ol2zhJpD2LU;full"][/previewyoutube]
Bug Fix for Multiple Issues 
Here are the most important things that have been fixed:
[olist]
Fixed incorrect display of inventory item thumbnails in the Inventory tab

Fixed marker buoys accepted in club chat not showing up in 3D until the game was restarted

Fixed Club-Series Glowing Pear-Shaped Float not glowing properly

Corrected the description text for a rod stand in the shop

Resolved incorrect appearance of navigation buoys in photo mode

With the introduction of the new Live Baits category, the Japanese Squid has been reassigned to it. As a result, it can no longer be used with bottom rods. If you had setups where bottom rods were equipped with this bait, the Japanese Squid will now be unequipped and automatically moved to your Backpack.

Fixed an exploit where trolling bonus was granted while the boat engine was running and anchored

Resolved an error occurring when attempting to teleport using navigation buoys

Fixed an issue where players couldn’t place a rod on a rod stand after competition scoring time ended

Updated achievement tracking: Nile Perch now counts toward the Perch Captain achievement

Fixed text overflow on the MAKE CAPTAIN (PREMIUM) button in French

The level for some Saltwater Braid Lines was changed.

Resolved issue with shared buoys not appearing in the accept list

Adjusted overly bright lighting on some objects during morning sun

Fixed competition ending unexpectedly when trying to change spot

Improved tab focus behavior when changing days or switching between tabs

Corrected rod name display in the 3D view

Resolved issue where players on boats could pass through other boats due to collision settings

Removed unnecessary close button (X) for controller users in the Stats window

Fixed character model misalignment when rotating camera on kayak in photo mode

Smoothed out slingshot animation in both first-person and third-person views

Resolved overflow issue in the Friends > Options menu with more than 6 options

Fixed heavy collision between fishing gear and grass on the San Joaquin pier

Adjusted tournament description text to display properly across multiple languages

Closed an exploit spot behind the rock with water access on the Selenge River

The in-game shop price for Squid Chains was changed to balance the game economics system.

Resolved mouse freeze issue in Epic Games Store after entering via controller from the BUY button

Improved image loading stability across all platforms

Restored missing 'SE' label on the SpellLauncher™ 320 SE rod in 3D view

Fixed issue where player briefly appeared on shore before spawning on yacht after Fishing Together session

Resolved graphical glitch where gray squares appeared after deleting a template

Fixed an issue where fish couldn’t be reeled in after forwarding time under specific conditions

Corrected translation in Spanish localization

Fixed license appearing in UI but missing in 3D view

Resolved error message "Selected Room has not been found..." when joining Fishing Together session from another pond

Fixed connection issue when joining friend’s room after being in a Private/Club Room and traveling from the Globe

Addressed UI rendering issues on macOS

This one is just a small token of appreciation for those dedicated players who read the release notes — and every single bug fix — from start to finish. Tell us in the comments you are the one who did it!

Fixed ocean water not displaying properly on M1 Mac processors

Resolved issue preventing completion of the Congo Chercheur achievement
[/olist]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9c666f1a015da342662376947ed69f18c38e26c1.png"]

We want to thank our incredible community for all the excitement and support you've shown from the very first announcement of Noomaa Kuda Atholhu, Maldives to its official release. It is you who make it all possible and inspire us at every step as we continue to build fishing locations all around the globe in Fishing Planet! Let’s celebrate this release together and create some unforgettable moments under the Maldivian sun. 

And don’t forget to grab your little gift to carry that island vibe with you wherever your fishing adventures take you.



Tight lines and see you on the water!



_______________________________________________________________

We have just released a new bug fix patch, now available on Steam. We are currently working on releasing the same patch for the Epic Games Store, and it should be available within the next few hours. Please, make sure to check for the latest version and download the update to get these changes in the game as this release will not get downloaded automatically.

 Corrected the fins animation in photomode and third person view when the fish is hanging on lip grip or hook.
 Fixed a visual defect at the connection between the leader and the main fishing line while holding a fish caught by trolling.
 Fixed endless spool unwinding when casting beyond terrain boundaries.

 Fixed the Splake fish missing textures issue.
 Seagulls now properly display at lower video quality settings.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

This update will soon be available on consoles, and we are actively working on resolving the remaining issues to bring the new Dnipro River map to mobile platforms. It will still take at least several weeks before we will be able to release it.

Thank you for your patience, valuable feedback and support as we continue to refine and enhance Fishing Planet!

Tight lines and happy fishing!

notes.title: Release Note: Dnipro River, Ukraine
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e6548db24c4ccd7074bbf533a46ee6424fda0570.png

Welcome to the Dnipro River, Ukraine, a new Level 46 location on Fishing Planet, and a place near and dear to the hearts of the game's developers!

32 fish species,  including well-known favorites such as Carp, Northern Pike, European Perch, Zander, Wels Catfish, Grass Carp, Silver Carp, and the iconic Beluga. And new to the game, White-Eye Bream, Common Nase, Sterlet, European Weatherfish, Chinese Sleeper, rare and valuable Black Sea Roach and locals’ favorite Azov Shad.

Freshwater trolling is finally here and it is available at all the locations in the game! Set out on the brand-new Dnipro motorboat, or give trolling a try with the rental boat available right at Dnipro River. 

Troll for Wels Catfish, Northern Pike and Zander and see how these mighty predators love the brand new Twerky Runner lures! An interesting fact about how Ukrainian anglers fish for Wels Catfish is that it is caught in these areas by trolling at night, while in other countries it is usually caught from the shore. 

Grab the Dnipro Delta Pack and set off in the Dnipro Motorboat, complete with two rod holders for trolling. Get two durable casting and spinning setups, a full range of tackles and lures, and a stylish outfit adorned with traditional designs. Enjoy a 30-day fishing trip on the Dnipro River, surrounded by serene water lilies and willows, with license and Premium account covered!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3351850/Fishing_Planet_Dnipro_Delta_Pack/

Discover new baits that are favorites among Ukrainian anglers, including Salo, Mamaliga, and Corn Sticks. And don’t miss the irresistible new groundbaits—featuring flavors like gingerbread and baked milk—that will have the fish biting and, who knows, maybe even make your mouth water too!

New lures, like Twerky Runners, Cicadas, Freaky Walkers, Bionic Slugs and Thorn Jig Heads, including a barbless one will be a pleasure to use for the local predators.

As in every new location, you get plenty of new missions and achievements, 4 new competitions and even two Monster missions! The Sturgeon Leviathan returns, alongside a brand-new threat, the Thorn-Ripper, waiting to be defeated.

Please, note some updates on other locations: European Weatherfish was also added to Lesni Villa, Czech Republic, and another addition to this update, driven by player requests, will be the ability to take Beluga at the Dnipro River. Similarly, we’ve made this option available for European Eel at the Tiber River, Ghent-Terneuzen Canal, and Sander Baggersee Lake. Since these species are endangered in real life, we’ve made them available to take in the game, ensuring no harm to the planet while still offering players the chance to experience the thrill of keeping them virtually. Be aware that this option is available for anglers with Advanced Licenses. 

https://youtu.be/T2jQpi02r5s 

Go ahead and start exploring the new map, or bear with us for the second part, which is equally important for players. We've resolved a number of issues, including the much-anticipated fix for the bass boat shaking bug, when the screen was shaking after hitting an object when driving a bass boat. Additionally, in response to feedback from players with special hearing needs, we've adjusted the Hell Bell sound, lowering its frequency to ensure that everyone can hear it clearly and comfortably.

Another exciting new feature is the redesigned UI for the Competitions rules section. Players will now be able to easily see the equipment, lures, or baits required for each competition, and if they are already equipped in the inventory, a green check will appear next to them. This feature is just the first iteration and will be refined in future updates, but we hope this small change will enhance the player experience by reducing confusion and making it easier to prepare for competitions.

One particularly amusing issue that has now been addressed involved extending the field for the credits balance. This adjustment became necessary because one of our players achieved the maximum possible amount of in-game currency! What an incredible milestone—congratulations on this remarkable achievement! The field has now been expanded to accommodate even higher balances. Way to go!

Here is what else has been included into the bug fix patch:

Tournaments
1. Fixed graphical artifacts appearing on tournament banners swaying in the wind.
2. Improved localization support for the Tournament Details Popup.
3. Corrected the boat type identification during tournaments.
4. Fixed issues with tournament joining mechanisms becoming unavailable after the tournament started.
5. The "Apply" button no longer appears after the tournament has started.
6. Addressed an issue blocking player interaction after reopening the game client during a tournament.
7. Resolved the problem where the player's previous competition results window returned them to the shore.

UI and Graphics Improvements
8. Redesigned the Template Received and Cooldown windows.
9. Fixed the wrong color of buttons on Repair and Wear & Tear modal windows.
10. Enhanced the Buy/Sell windows with better clarity and usability.
11. Adjusted the incorrect item quantities displayed in the Mission tab.
12. Corrected blurred user avatar images on the profile tab.
13. Fixed UI alignment issues, such as misplaced "check" icons during boat purchases.
14. Updated Reel of Fortune UI to ensure compatibility with gamepad inputs.
15. Improved club management with the ability to change short names in club descriptions.

Physics and Gameplay Fixes
16. Adjusted lure behavior consistency when holding the rod in hands.
17. Reduced excessive foam around fish when reeling them in closer.
18. Resolved the "flying fish" bug on Rocky Lake.
19. Corrected the glowing shader for Tench and Golden Tench fish.

Sound Adjustments
20. Lowered the volume of splashes and other ambient fish activity sounds.
21. Fixed sound inconsistencies with tournament flags.
22. Resolved an issue where tournament flags emitted wind-flapping sounds despite being static.

Game Stability and Functionality
23. Resolved crashes in photo mode caused by pressing "P".
24. Fixed crashes occurring when hosts forwarded time during FT sessions.
25. Prevented the endless processing window when users tried to leave regular competitions during registration.
26. Addressed crashes when trying to interact with rods after minimizing and reopening the game.

Miscellaneous Fixes
27. Adjusted the shader for Golden Tench and Tench fish to fix translucency issues.
28. Resolved problems with boat movement and captain status interactions.

30. Fixed a bug when the Fish Species window for Saint-Croix Lake was appearing empty after opening another waterway.
31. Resolved the appearance of a large white figure opposite Sander Baggersee Lake.
32. Other minor fixes and adjustments.

We hope you enjoy exploring the Dnipro River and the enhancements included in this update. From the new map to bug fixes and UI improvements, these changes aim to make your experience smoother and more enjoyable. Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to your feedback.

notes.title: Akhtuba River: Important Update for Anglers
notes.notes:
Dear Anglers,

We would like to inform the community that in approximately three weeks, the Akhtuba River location will be removed from the game. To ensure a smooth transition, we have prepared a comprehensive compensation plan for all players affected by this change:

Relocation and Refunds

 All players present at the Akhtuba River location at the time of its removal will be transferred to the Global Map.
 Any travel expenses, unused paid stay costs, and boat rental fees for this location will be refunded in full.

Keepnet Fish

 If you have fish in your keepnets at the time of removal, they will be automatically sold, and the credits will be added to your account.

License Refunds

 Players with active licenses for the Akhtuba River location will be compensated for any unused days.
 For players with unlimited licenses, the full cost of the license will be refunded.

Marker Buoy Reimbursement

 Any Marker Buoys used at this location will be returned to you and made available for use at other locations

Achievement and Mission Completion

 Achievements in progress at the Akhtuba River location will be marked as completed.
 Players in the middle of completing the exploration mission for this location will also have the mission marked as completed.


All compensations will be processed automatically, and your in-game balance will be updated to reflect the adjustments outlined above. If you have any questions, feel free to contact support@fishingplanet.com, we will be happy to help.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation as we work to make this transition as seamless as possible. Our team remains committed to delivering the best possible experience for all anglers.

Tight lines and don’t forget the Thanksgiving Event is live now, so don’t miss out!

XP in Fishing Together sessions has also been boosted - the more players on the boat, the more XP each of you will receive. Additionally, don’t forget that you get an XP bonus when fishing with your club mates, so fishing with them on the same boat is always a win-win.

We’ve also modified the fish fights, making it easier to reel in big catches faster, and as a result allowing you to gain more XP in less time.

After receiving feedback about the Fishing Together Mastering Missions being too difficult, we've made some adjustments to make them more achievable. The amounts of fish needed to catch in all three missions have been reduced. notes.title: Patch Note 5.0.2
notes.notes:
Dear Anglers,

We have just released another patch addressing bug fixes and improvements reported over the past few days. While there are still a few issues we're actively working on, rest assured these will be resolved in the next hotfix patch. We appreciate your patience and continued support as we work diligently to enhance your gaming experience.

In addition, we'd like to address an important matter: we've conducted another ban wave based on our anti-cheating reports. Currently, these bans are temporary, but this is for the last time, and they will become permanent if those players attempt to use cheating software again. We want to stress that using any third-party software to alter gameplay in Fishing Planet is strictly forbidden and will result in a permanent ban.

Responding to some concerns about us joining the list of games that use Denuvo anti-cheat, we want to assure you that Denuvo operates with minimal impact on performance, ensuring a smooth gaming experience, and prioritizes user privacy, collecting only necessary data to prevent cheating. This improvement was primarily made to fulfill our community's request, and we firmly believe it will ensure a safe and fair gaming environment for all.

Lastly, we’ve been receiving many questions about the release of the Ocean Update for consoles and mobile platforms. We know you’re eagerly awaiting this update and appreciate your enthusiasm. The ocean update has turned out so huge that we needed to take some more time to optimize it better for smooth performance on all the devices. We will announce the release date within a few days, so stay tuned and thank you for your patience.

Here is the list of resolved issues:


 Fixed the twitching animation issue on the 3D retrieve indicator.
 Addressed the system lag accompanied by a characteristic sound.
 Fixed the issue where pressing the "A" button did not open the first mission group list after switching mission group tabs.
 Adjusted the speed at which fish drag boats and kayaks. Now, the speed better correlates with the fish's weight and strength and the weight of the boat.We've made it slightly faster based on players' feedback while keeping the mechanic realistic.
 Bottom/Feeder Setup: Correctly displays the sinker when viewing the setup in templates.
 Fixed the issue where the rented yacht would sink after the player came ashore on the Kaiji No Ri island.
 Fixed game logic initialization for placing rods on stands in the settings.
 The yacht no longer tips over after being returned to its start position.
 Improved server performance for the Ocean Update
 Fixed the issue where the background in photo mode did not change for the guest after teleporting to a navigation buoy in Fishing Together sessions.
 Addressed the occasional weather desynchronization between the host and guest after time rewinds in Fishing Together sessions.
 The boat rental window no longer appears twice if the session time ends while the host is offline.
 Fixed the issue where players would spawn directly in the boat during the Fishing Planet Boat Series Tournament.
 Club List now correctly displays clubs from all regions when filtering by country with "All" selected.
 Resolved the intermittent inability to navigate with a gamepad in Kaiji Ni Ri location.
 Fixed the issue where the guest saw the host's cast rod detach from the boat and move away after joining a Fishing Together session.
 Bait is now correctly consumed on the Livebait Trolling Rig.
 The "Tight Lines!" achievement is now properly credited on Steam.

Tight lines and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch Note 5.0.1
notes.notes:
Dear Anglers,

Yesterday marked a historic day for Fishing Planet with the release of the Ocean Update, and we're thrilled to see your excitement! We've received tons of feedback from you, and while many of you are loving the new ocean features, we know there are a few things you didn't like as much. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, so we wanted to address some of the most talked-about issues before we share the list of bug fixes and improvements.

We've heard your concerns about the Denuvo Anti-Cheat software. We want to assure you that Denuvo is designed to prioritize user privacy, collecting only the necessary data to prevent cheating. In the first 24 hours, we identified and dealt with many cheating players, helping to ensure a fair and enjoyable experience for everyone.

Some of you have mentioned that reels wear out quickly when using max drag. We understand this makes the gameplay more challenging, but max drag wasn't intended to be used the way it has been. This change is meant to make the game feel more realistic. To keep your reels in good shape, try to avoid using max drag continuously.

Last but not least, regarding the time-forward cooldown during nighttime: we initially enabled it because many fish species are active at night. However, after hearing your feedback, we’ve decided to revert this change. There will no longer be a nighttime cooldown, so you can enjoy uninterrupted gameplay.

Here is the list of other bug fixes and improvements:


 Corrected boat antenna rotation in Fish Radar.
 Fixed a bug where the guest would experience a freeze and black screen when the host finishes a Fishing Together session.
 Corrected the message displayed upon event mission completion.
 Applied minor fixes to the XP Modifiers window.
 Implemented minor fixes for Ocean Missions.
 Resolved an issue where players would be placed in a different room after returning to a Fishing Together session.
 Fixed texture issues on the Scutum Boat.
 Addressed an overlap of multiple tags on the same spot on the Tablet in Fishing Together sessions.
 Applied various physics fixes.
 Relocated navigation buttons for switching tablet modes.
 Fixed UI bugs in different tablet modes.
 Resolved an issue where the boat wouldn't move if the player at the helm was changed while in reverse.
 Corrected the message about the end of the map displayed on the local map.
 Fixed animation issues for big reels where the hand texture was seen through the sleeve while reeling.
 Prevented the Extended Fishing Together session window from appearing in the guest's window after accessing the local map.
 Fixed performance degradation during long play sessions.
 Fixed a minor bug with Club invites.
 Implemented anti-cheat improvements.
 Resolved a photo mode bug for the Monster Fish Striped Marlin and other minor issues in photo mode
 Fixed an issue where the yacht would tip over and fly up high after being anchored.
 Corrected the pale appearance of boat and kayak slots compared to other slots.
 Fixed the issue where saltwater sinkers were not working in carp setups.
 Resolved the problem where it was impossible to buy items from the Lures and Baits category tabs in the Global Shop.
 Applied various fixes to the Shop interface.
 Fixed the preview for empty templates.
 Optimized server workload for better performance.


Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. We hope you enjoy the improvements!
The Fishing Planet Team

notes.title: Release Note 5.0.0: Ocean Update
notes.notes:
​{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/016e1857e5eb32e7d67798031e4c3674fc461fbb.png

Hey Anglers,

The most expected release note in the Fishing Planet’s history has arrived. Let’s go!
Here is what’s new:


 Kaiji No Ri, Japan New map with an enormous 400 sq km (almost 100,000 acres) of ocean, home to 18 dynamically moving fish species, including Bluefin Tuna, Striped Marlin, Mahi Mahi, plus Bigfin Reef Squid, among others. Accessible to players at level 83, with a new maximum level cap raised to 90, this expansive location offers a wealth of new challenges and opportunities. As customary in Fishing Planet, players of lower levels can unlock access to the map by purchasing a DLC pack with a pond pass for 30 and even 60 days. This time, we're offering two DLC packs, providing you with greater flexibility and convenience in choosing their preferred option!

 Ocean water simulation As a standout feature that deserves extra attention, incredibly lifelike ocean water simulation, complete with various types of waves, including intense storms. The ocean's appearance will dynamically change based on weather conditions and wind patterns, offering a truly captivating experience. Immerse yourself further with realistic sounds of birds, wind, and water splashes, enhancing the authenticity of your ocean adventure.

 Sea Life Simulation System Featuring dynamic zones that highlight schools of predatory fish near the water's surface, birds actively hunting for bait fish, and pods of dolphins and majestic blue whales gracefully navigating the ocean depths. Immerse yourself further with additional elements such as cruise liners, regattas, and trawler boats, creating a vibrant and lifelike maritime environment that dynamically changes depending on the time of the day and weather.

 Fishing Together Now, you can enjoy fishing with 2, 3, or 4 players on the same boat, depending on your chosen vessel. Invite your fellow anglers for a fishing party, and even let them take the wheel if you fancy. Plus, you'll earn an additional XP bonus for Fishing Together! The more anglers you have onboard, the higher the bonus for each of you. And if you're all clubmates, you'll also receive the club room XP bonus. Fishing Together also implies that the players share common fishing conditions: common bite rate, weather, and time for all participants. Rest assured it doesn’t mean that your fellow anglers can catch all of the fish and leave not Dive into an exclusive series of group missions and achievements, tailored specifically for Fishing Together, a first in Fishing Planet!

 Brand new fishing yachts for ocean fishing All the new boats are compatible for Fishing Together sessions. Rent a boat for two players using in-game credits, or opt for the Scutum™ and Volans™ Fishing Yachts accommodating 3 and 4 players respectively, available in DLC packs. All boats feature two rod holders for each player, allowing one more additional rod in hands. There’s no longer a need for a keepnet when fishing on a boat, as all boats are now equipped with ample built-in fish storage. Equipped with state-of-the-art FishFinders 360™, these vessels detect fish across surface, mid, and bottom water layers. Navigate with precision using the new Detailed Navigation Map, Echo Sounder, Compass, and Speedometer panel.

 In addition to the boat control panel equipment Players get new Tablet software that will have not only usual tools such as already familiar to players marker buoys, but also new Navigation buoys, and additional Tabs with Echo Sounder and Fish Finder 360™, which will become available after players complete special Maintenance Adventures missions.  

 Navigation buoys New special buoys, available on the new location, used to mark your favorite fishing spots and teleport among them for fast and easy exploration of such a vast location.
 
 Over 500 new saltwater items Over 500 new saltwater items are now available in local and global shops! These additions include delicious fresh baits like spiny lobsters, flying squid, gutted fish, and innovative saltwater lures such as pilkers, plugs, squid jigs, bucktails, trolling octopuses, and teasers like squid chains. Equip yourself with the latest super powerful saltwater gear, designed to reel in massive ocean fish weighing over 270 kg (almost 600 lb)! There is a new addition to the Global shop: the Saltwater Tackle section, featuring all the saltwater items. For your convenience, these items are included in all the shop's dropdown menus. Special high-performance saltwater equipment was added to the Premium Shop as well.

 As mentioned above, two Ocean DLC packs are now available for purchase Players can choose between two fishing yachts that hold 3 or 4 players for Fishing Together. Both packs include powerful gear, multiple baits and lures, additional storage slots, and tackle wagons for up to 300 tackles. 

 The Japan Odyssey Pack offers a larger four-seater boat, a 60-day pond pass with an advanced license, and more marker and navigation buoys.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922540/Fishing_Planet_Japan_Odyssey_Pack/

 The Ocean Voyager Pack provides a smaller boat for three players, a 30-day pond pass with an advanced license, and marker and navigation buoys. Both packs allow players to bring friends and have all the necessary items for saltwater fishing. Choose the one that best suits your needs.   

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922530/Fishing_Planet_Ocean_Voyager_Pack/


 Saltwater trolling  Fishing technique used in the ocean where one or more fishing lines, baited with lures or baitfish, are drawn through the water behind a moving boat. This method targets various saltwater species, including larger pelagic fish like tuna, marlin, etc. which are known to chase moving prey. Saltwater trolling is a dynamic and exciting way to fish, offering anglers the opportunity to cover large areas of water and target a variety of species in different oceanic conditions.

 Free spool mechanics Which will enhance your fishing experience, especially for bottom fishing at great depths. This feature is available on all reels in the game, whether for saltwater or freshwater fishing. It allows for precise control of your line, enabling free immersion of lures or sinkers to significant depths with an open spool and securing the line at the desired depth with a closed spool. This added functionality offers greater accuracy, especially when the bottom topography is unknown and considering the fact that the depth of the ocean will be more than 100 meters at many spots, making it easier to target specific depths and fish species.

 Completely revamped the Pull-and-Reel mechanics system Provide a more immersive and realistic fishing experience, mirroring the dynamics of ocean fishing. Expect fish fights to be more challenging but also more rewarding, as they replicate the true struggle of reeling in massive ocean catches. 

 Gaff
Gaff animation for the retrieval and retention of large ocean fish.

 New Competitive Activities and Rewards 4 new Kaiji No Ri competitions, 11 achievements, 20 new exclusive saltwater X-series items
 
 Dozens of new missions Including exclusive Fishing Together missions that can be accomplished only with other anglers on the same boats, and Maintenance Adventures to improve the equipment you use on your Tablet as s reward.

 New anti-cheating solution We are dedicated to providing a fair and enjoyable gaming experience for everyone. To combat cheating and ensure a level playing field, we integrated the Denuvo Anti-Cheat system for Steam and Epic Games Store players. This decision highlights our commitment to maintaining the integrity of our game and protecting our community from unfair practices. You can find out more about it here.
 
 A small but nice new addition: meet the very first NPC in the game!  The marina administrator, who works tirelessly from early morning until late night, ensures the port runs smoothly and loves cats. He might need your assistance with calibrating new navigation tools. When you spot him, don't hesitate to approach and ask if he requires any help. You will also have a chance to deliver some treats to the kitty-cats on the pier.

 Reel of Fortune After many player requests, The Reel of Fortune is finally available on Steam.

 Time forwarding cooldown has been added during nighttime  The day cooldown was originally implemented when night fishing wasn't part of the game, the night cooldown became necessary later on. Considering the numerous fish species in the ocean actively biting during both day and night, adding the night cooldown was essential with this update. An important thing to note is that there won’t be any cooldown for forwarding time to the next morning when selling fish.
UPD: After hearing players' feedback, we’ve decided to revert this change. There will no longer be a nighttime cooldown, so you can enjoy uninterrupted gameplay.

 Changes in deterministic user-generated competitions  As requested by players, there will be less randomness. The weather and bite rates now match real conditions on the waterways, meaning dedicated training will give you a better chance to win, making the process more fair and rewarding.

 New start screen While the game loads, you'll now see a stunning 3D ocean scene featuring boats, birds, dolphins, and a whale breaching the water.
 
 New settings options  Players can now adjust the volume of boat sounds and regulate water quality with more precision.

 Numerous bug fixes and enhancements Have been implemented, including updates to the reel damage system and drag behavior to eliminate exploits related to the "unbreakable setup”. We’ve also implemented a new wear system for tackles: freshwater items will wear out faster in ocean water, just as they do in real life. As the bugfix list is very long, we suggest reading it in a different article HERE.


We're thrilled to announce the completion of this monumental update and extend our gratitude to all of you for your patience during its development. We eagerly await your feedback and wish you an incredible experience out on the ocean!

Welcome Congo River!

We are happy to announce that now you can enjoy fishing in the heart of Africa - Congo River! Welcome 7 unique locations with 17 species of unique African fish, which can’t be found anywhere else in the world, a bunch of new tackles and baits, unique African flora, and fauna, that will bring your fishing experience to a new level!
 
More information about the new waterway in our Dev's Diaries!

You can explore the variety of the Congo River on 7 locations


 Cable Ferry{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1bc485732227c518419084d52a7499919cdf2193.png
The north of the reservoir houses a small boat dock. Local anglers are just about the only people you would meet here, as they use it to secure their distinctive long boats. Although this place might seem unremarkable at first, it’s quiet and calm, and everything allows for a leisurely fishing experience.

 Waterfall Roar
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/44febb753d1bf341f3e903ebe1281ca209c22c46.png
Island Mabanga, situated in the southern central part of the water body, owes its name to the fact that it’s made up of stone slabs and boulders. Local anglers know it as a great place to hunt for Tigerfish, because these predators are attracted by the fast current just before the waterfalls. Make sure your tackle is sturdy enough to hold the feisty fish, and enjoy the exciting fight as you listen to the waterfall’s roar and tropical bird calls.

 Local School
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6c4ab2ec0ace1877173d1cdf85a317c4da5fdf4f.png
Situated among palm trees on the east bank of the river is a small local school, attended by children from nearby villages. A neat stone church is located nearby, where parishioners from the surrounding area come every Sunday to listen to the sermon and discuss the latest news. This well-tended place puts you in the mood for pleasant contemplation of nature and peaceful fishing.

 Wild Islands
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/35648099ec6e2f34e9dc23273bfdb3fd45c3b6d4.png
If you want to leave behind the frantic turmoil of civilization just for a day, welcome to the Wild Islands, located in the western part of the river. Local fish enjoy hiding in thickets of underwater grass and among numerous stumps, snags and tree roots growing right in the waters.

 Bomuna Settlement
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8bd6c31bd6b3fb3b2b2f6b06a9954271f71636f8.png
The village of Bomuna is located on the eastern bank of the Congo. Early in the morning, local anglers leave their ramshackle clay houses, set off from an old wooden dock in their dugout canoes, and fish using methods that haven’t changed since ancient times. 

 Forgotten Village
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ba8f6abaa432b7c6d52ec2a2a070496dbfb40613.png
This abandoned fishing settlement is situated on the western bank directly opposite the local village. It’s not possible to fish from the shore, since it’s too swampy to land. If you decide to go around the village using the wooden pier, be careful: it regularly suffers from the river pushing against it, and only rare anglers walk on its decaying planks.

 Hanging Bridges
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4093f0a4f6e3ba3e3487949e75778d84e6f960a7.png
This multi-level intricate network of suspended bridges has transformed a group of islands in the center of the pool into a real labyrinth. Only locals know which bridges lead to which islands. But on the other hand, this amazing place makes it possible to feel like a real discoverer, since each path can take you to a secluded fishing nook that is so exciting to explore.

 African Sedge

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f5a6ad1923c498bedb8e345fa43e86eea3fe543b.png

notes.title: Patch Note 3.5.9: 4 new Fish in Mississippi.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4db1fcf060761a4cb148da273e0fc39542b6eb3f.jpg

Hello, anglers!

Welcome, 4 new inhabitants of shoreless Blue Crab Island in Mississippi.


 The first one on our list is Shoal Bass, cousin of the Bigmouth and Smallmouth Bass. This indigenous freshwater inhabitant of the southern part of the USA, easily recognizable by its colorful body and aggressive behavior.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ea5a964a9753318659cf14a658053ce43f40f649.png
 The second one is Bigmouth Buffalo. One of the biggest species in the Catostomidae family, native North American freshwater fish, mostly known for its giant size and its long lifespan. Despite being mostly planktivorous species, it easily could be caught on sports gear. So choose the right bait and good luck!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dc140e379ba9958d132cad8dcd58b584f07dbe46.png
 The third one is American Gizzard Shad. This small-sized, extremely fecund and gluttonous member of the herring family serves as a feeding base for many freshwater predators. But due to the enabling environment of the Blue Crab Island, it has grown to a very impressive size and catching fish more than 1 kg is not so rare. Although American Gizzard Shad feeds mainly on plankton, here in the south it also willingly bites! Arm yourself with small hooks and the same small nozzle - and you are guaranteed success!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c78dc1d273f89b4f1a2312dfaca50b14c8202956.png
 Last but not the least interesting fish species is the Black Drum. This giant inhabitant of the sea depths, well known as the largest of all the drum family. Its behavior is very common to his close relative Red Drum, and you need to look for it in approximately the same places.
   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/32c0178df31d41a696f7ef22c37cba0a67e28bf4.png


Tight Lines!

notes.title: Patch 3.4.0 New Waterway - Mississippi Blue Crab Island!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/877e2d647d4a86d1b28cd9a01aebfcde84b29175.png

Are you ready for fabulous fishing?
Welcome to Mississippi Blue Crab Island! This picturesque place is a real paradise for anglers in the azure waters of the northern part of the Gulf of Mexico.

The trip to the Blue Crab Island is the dream of any experienced angler. Only the singing of birds and the buzzing of insects interrupt the local silence and solitude. Along the canals – thickets of sawgrass, the water here hides many large species. You can fish from a wooden pontoon near the boat station, or you can take a motor, go for a spin along the mangrove, and enjoy nature away from the coast and closer to the inhabitants of saltwater.

You've got a big party to plan here:

New level cap
Existing leveling system will be increased to 55 levels in maximum. The Mississippi Blue Crab Island will be available for all users who gained level 54. 

Locations
Despite the waterway’s impressive size, there will be  two entry locations.
The first location  - Mangrove Sunset - is situated next to a large stilt house, right in the center of the waterway and is a great spot to start exploring both fresh and saltwater areas by boat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dc41344d72942af83acac6a46dae023350b6c419.png

The second location -  The Bass Base - is on wooden docks in the middle of a freshwater bay, amidst natural wild scenery and black mangrove trees.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/659bd07b4b81dcf3aa98090e4366a97fb2927c4e.png

Keep in mind that Mississippi is a waterway made specifically for boats and you can explore it in all possible ways.  You can also land anywhere along the coast.

New fish species
Skilled anglers have a chance to catch new fish.

Bonefish, 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/75c273e0359d32bc370a10d42510e0704fbf3624.png
Speckled Peacock Bass,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/72042b5ad97f69e9f6b000b32b75dd1d70ba1617.png
Southern Flounder
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/659ffea173315e1b66a40b4204c84f9ac3694acd.png
and Permit.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6987ccc996892ec801352f0d464e6b2d4685455a.png

New Trophy and Unique fish

Although at first glance the pond seems calm, it hides many fish, each of which is a welcome trophy: Tarpon, Red Drum, Snook, as well as a relic resident of the local waters – the Longnose Gar.

New reinforced fishing rods and reels for catching really powerful species

Spinning Rods  Thetis™
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6b4e83deb578ef8bad698ee756771b34651531e7.png
Rivertex™ presents Thetis™ - the new and most powerful yet spinning rod that bears the name of a mighty sea goddess! An all-round superior choice for spin angling, this beauty is perfect for catching feisty beasts like trophy-sized bass, pike, salmon and muskies! Packed with Rivertex™ leading-edge technologies, like the ultra slim high modulus MaxCarbon™ alloy blank and the ResinFix™reinforcement method, this superb masterpiece of a rod features divine design to match its superior performance!

Spin Reels    ExcelSpinner™
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8c38d822f5fdb6a80bc3443dc579aacdd6046d08.png
ExcelSpinner™ is a new and even more powerful spinning reel from Rivertex™ with an elegant bronze TCP™ finish to match its might! The reel’s super large spool will make it much easier to land those trophies, while leading-edge technologies of ARTEX Slim™ reel body, HydroStop™ corrosion protected bearings and the exclusive StraighLine™ anti-backlash system ensure exceptional performance and superb durability!

Match Rods    Majesty™ 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/68baf9e15d1ea0bccf7ece25a99e02da50350d2b.png
Majesty™ is a much-awaited new and superb addition to the Rivermatch™ premium line of match rods from Rivertex™. A high-quality versatile match rod, Majesty™ features a super light and powerful blank made with the latest MaxCarbon™ high-modulus carbon fiber alloys and ResinFix™ unique curing technology to ensure optimal angling performance. Complete with FGS™ guide system and top-grade handles for improved grip, this exceptional rod is the perfect balance between power, precision and control.

Spin Reels    Empress™
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0b4aa834e9d40d7f1f1c2749b7d97f229ad8fcbb.png
Rivertex™ presents the Empress™ - a new high-performance spinning reel that is exceptionally designed for ultimate use with match rods. Packed with the company’s latest technological advancements like the EasyDrag™ and StraightLine™ anti-backlash system, the Empress™ is also equipped with MegaRoller™ smooth line roller mechanism and super durable tungsten carbide corrosion resistant TCBearings™, making it a super powerful and regal weapon for landing some big monsters!

Casting Rods    SharpCaster™ 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/62970518a4c53343b3773ec4414081fa336a5644.png
Yet another tackle masterpiece from Rivertex™, the SharpCaster™ is the company’s newest and most powerful casting rod that is great for hunting the toughest trophy-size predators. Boasting a MaxCarbon™ alloy blank in stylish electric green design and impressive muscle power due to the ResinFix™ curing method and reinforced ARTEX™ body lining technology, this superb angling weapon will keep your aim sharp and fishing battles ablaze like never before!

Cast Reels    PowerGrab™
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8f98bf45672c5543b47ac8c7722b712ea604fd05.png
A new and mega powerful casting reel from Rivertex™, the PowerGrab™ boasts delightful accuracy and unmatched precision, making it a lethal weapon for hunting predators. Equipped with all of the top Rivertex™ reel technologies, including EasyDrag™ and renowned StraighLine Duo™ anti backlash system, the PowerGrab™ is encased into a fully-machined, solid-built ARTEX™ frame and features a cool fresh design that ensure utmost durability and chic style!

New Spinning Leaders, Titanium and Fluorocarbon, for catching toothed fish.

Titanium Leader, extremely tough and durable. The perfect option for making sure you don’t lose a sharp-toothed predator halfway through the fish fight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e7024445a0d50c300aac8b296d04da8a81b8c85f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3aca46c6809ad71e1362747ab09bbc45a6249de9.png
Fluorocarbon Leader, sensitive and strong, virtually invisible in the water, the perfect choice for tricking those sharp-sighted predators into biting!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4400483928d6ec9011d771e564f13f43dd5dd7af.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a2a47359b586f960134d9553b20b6787b060c236.png

New lures and softbaits, including Buzzbaits, Twin Tail Spider Grubs, Slugs and Larva!
Buzzbaits
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c9ef265b8a7da7aeda4838d624d81afa286a58b5.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/365d8ca9aa0367e05ec1e06e3072f9faa9439fab.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/428220474137db9339803eff22a4bf3c666f8f95.png

SpiderGrab
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9d4e4380b84b220e1dda27c6c82657fe53a69a47.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bd07bf0687723c47903cbcbd6525c3f989228a64.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f8997bd511c9c9f9e06cc2cd5ec9541155a82e50.png

Slug
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8e0fb2aaa2f3057976f8b0d4488844a2e7430e65.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4cdb01d477cd1c873ec2111e929e43de50f5f671.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/305e6e43bed81c66f119163ca7c10fe4d1b55bb4.png

Larva
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d5eaac50144ad45c3898a6c8fa0dc6d3ff2c3fa6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e13cb5d0b5fcf6bac6f9688d2b64fb8a09dd38af.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/59f711582c261dd587bcac55b52298ceb277d4e8.png

If you want to check out Fishing Planet’s newest and biggest angling destination surrounded by the salty waters of the Gulf of Mexico, don't forget to grab our new pack:

Tune into exploration mode right NOW with the new Bassboat Explorer Pack!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/77089336a2d739b341d91e780782cbe6110f3e98.jpg

This amazing all-you-need power pack includes:
 The speedy Garry Scott™ Scorpius™ Bass Boat for fishing adventures without limits!
 The latest and most powerful casting combo to handle the heaviest saltwater predators!
 New lures and softbaits, including Buzzbaits, Twin Tail Spider Grub, Slugs and more!
 Mississippi 30 Day Pond Pass and Advanced License for limitless fishing and exploring!The best professional anglers approve this set; it has everything you need for an unforgettable island adventure, plus an incredible bonus: Mississippi State License for 30 Day Fishing!


Grab your tackles and enjoy the island adventures!

Besides the new waterway, fish and tackle current update also includes:
 Free roaming
Now you can easily move around with gear in your hands while fighting fish. You can take out and hide the rod in any convenient place.

 Last position auto save
We have added auto save for your last position: now you can return to the very point where you were before exiting the game. This auto save would also work if your last position was on the boat, however it doesn't support saving position for the rod stands. 

 New Collections Missions:
Welcome 20 new collectionS missions. Gather your trophy collection by catching different fish species and underwater items.

 Dam Road - New location on White Moose  lake:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/52be6fe91f461d85e2946139e676264ac58834a4.png

The truly magical atmosphere of this remote and fantastically picturesque fishing location will offer you unmatched opportunities for fishing, especially if you are targeting Trout and Salmon, this fishing spot is the place to be for all those eager to enjoy the natural wonders of winter!

 Custom Competitions:
Competitive fishing becomes more profitable than before.
Added a possibility to apply for multiple sports events. We also added a new UI called "My sports events" where you can easily track all relevant events you applied for.
We are looking forward to your further feedback.


Don’t waste any time and give yourself an unforgettable fishing experience in a place where only a pleasant catch will bother you!

notes.title: Release Note 3.2.0: User Generated Competitions
notes.notes:
Hello, anglers!
And we’re finally rolling out the much awaited feature of User Generated Competitions and much more!
User Generated Competitions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/524bbb0dc70ef03f0e7c06cbc1e7008a13544dab.png

Now, you can create and customize competitive fishing events based on your own preferences, by fine-tuning and adjusting multiple event settings, including rules, locations, time schedules, participants and much more!

We designed a whole array of new tools to make it more comfortable for you to create and host just the perfect angling competitions and set numerous parameters to your preferences:  
 Use pre-existing templates or generate your fishing event from scratch!
 Select the competition formats (free for all/team/duel) and privacy settings.
 Set your own Entry Fee and Prize Pool.
 Choose from multiple settings, including location, number of participants, player LVLs, duration, time, weather conditions, tackle, qualifying fish, etc...!


We’ll tell you in more detail here how these new competitions are going to look like in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5d49df9703af7e21561a32e4bd34dbc8d5090ff8.png

A new Custom Competitions menu will be added to the game interface that’ll feature a convenient list of all the user competitors both available and already played.

New Complex Rigs with new types of terminal tackle:
Rigs. Yep, now you can use rigs with your spinning and casting rods: Texas Rig, California Rig. Three-way Rig and Flipping Rig- all to enhance your fishing experience!;)

Three-Way Rig

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/82da6293fce63dd6349d6949c54d378bc9356761.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/31ca792c4d1ae9fbed449b17ecf624dcf150bfca.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/886dea3225ecdf5fd3d3d82cd46ce99e76117429.png
One of the most well-known and simplest rigs, the three way rig features a three-way swivel that has separate attachment points for the main line, sinker and the leader. Easy to set up, the three way rig provides smooth rotating and eliminates line twists. Particularly efficient for going after predators like Catfish, Trout, Pike or Bass.

Texas Rig

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/383c8fdada27c94a5697d8703510c255b9735520.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/78408264aec59d93be2e37587fb8f1bfcc3908ce.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/aed606d16ac36da220074e3f215bc369fda5abaa.png
The Texas rig is one of the easiest and most effective ways to use soft plastic baits for bass fishing. Just slide some weights on the line, tie on a hook, thread on a soft plastic bait, like a plastic worm, tube or craw and you’re ready to catch some big bad bass!

Carolina Rig

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/de13b794b6e70f9c0ca463aa3ffe51d4bf6b0a90.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6c98a84568c8227f4a84eca89ad090c5f4d325fd.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/febbac6e9b21a87222c037620787f14c895482ed.png
The Carolina rig is a super effective plastic bait rig that is especially perfect for going after bottom feeding fish and fish like bass. In this rig setup, the weight is fixed above the hook, and can be used with a number of soft plastic baits, like worms, craws or tubes. The Carolina rig is suitable for beginner anglers.

Tear Drop and Bullet Sinkers 

 Tear Drop:
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/84767fe6128a1a4da3a5673f9d75e724d16ffd43.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d24336cc05364644ef12216b08607fc10a9fbdca.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5627d666c9e5e0209acf1592e36ac889d2926b88.png

 Bullet Sinkers:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/57aca8196b9786fac65ab2d38d83eb4b63897a98.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a80928c2d7452f1b308dd6509823b9c88459e053.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4ef4da59aba33bbbd5f0800f29d5645304826191.png


High-quality sinkers that are designed for use with jig rigs for spin fishing. These sinkers are one of the most popular choices among anglers.

Tails

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/03ab7ccbba7277a921c1839029761f16fc7483d9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6f93664f8005551d96f1fe9089768121d67a1d9d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/73bd07265217c301868da62feb4f4d573a84f703.png
An extremely efficient enhancement for lures such as spinners and spinnerbaits, Tails deliver superb flashing baitfish imitation, making them irresistible for predatory fish like Pike and Muskies.
New bite system for North America waterways
New Exploring missions:

notes.title: Release Note 3.0.1: Motorboats Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e612b10dde7f74536d5d01f85342d1d7775df5b2.png

Hi, anglers!
We are excited to present you our new update! Here you can find detailed information about what are waiting for you. Explore and be ready for new adventures!

1. Motorboats 

Now you can enjoy three new types of motorboats that have unique speed, durability and vary in other params and features. 

 Metal flat bottomed motorboats. 
Slow, cheap, but extremely durable boats. You can rent the basic metal boat. However, the other ones will be equipped with sonars and better engines
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/842fb818fce24ec45e6f3ef997aff8dfcca91bc2.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b3257486dc916b5c68ad463f85d3a6501e45f63f.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/69cd417cc95d5b2c81f85b8e5361603a0d44768a.png


 Rubber inflatable motorboats.
 These motorboats come with three various sonar options that vary by color themes, speed readings and fish tracking parameters. There are also boats with different engine powers.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6c3fff106d05bbe47a23e007630436c791292d4a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/721f4685f7b3600dcbf2ed5d1d1e616ed18a05d0.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f42b5bd6588e7143cb8aef66e8a16c05264d918a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bf99c9ee974fa230c87bb4faf2dcc894198e97a3.png


 Bassboats are equipped with the best bassboat edition sonars and can develop the highest speed of all motorboats. Also, some bassboats feature, along with a trolling motor, an additional sonar installed in the front part, so that you could look for fish without having to get behind the steering wheel. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/76b9c855520197b89a037f720cd9ca469890de43.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/81bc2ef822922b393799b0c25cbccc24bb27f1a3.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/26989233b1c55c22e390295ffdbbaf5162934ba8.png


You can purchase all types of motorboats in the in-game shop and enjoy them on the following waterways: 


 Emerald Lake
 Falcon Lake
 San Joaquin Delta
 Saint Croix Lake
 White Moose Lake
 Tiber River
 Sander Baggersee Lake
 Akhtuba River


A basic edition of metal flat bottomed motorboat is also available for rent at all of these waterways. Please note that only one type of boat (metal boat or kayak) may be rented at a time!

Types of Sonars
As mentioned before all motorboats purchased in the shop may be equipped with different types of sonars that vary by color themes, speed readings and fish tracking parameters. 


 Basic - shows bottom shape and structure and works on slow speed. Color theme: monochrome.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b827984002e87de0b39e5fb67c707e5abe37bfe4.png

 Advanced - shows bottom shape and structure as well as fish. Works on slow and middle speed. Color theme: monochrome
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3e54767d2d29ef2e3780ded25d6ea37ab1fdcebf.png


 Pro - shows fish as well as bottom shape and structure in high resolution. Works on slow, middle and high speeds. Color theme: colorful.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/81cb306699e54bab05d9ba7e16dfdc4cc94a88f3.png
 
 Also there is a  special edition sonar for the bassboat that corresponds to the Pro sonar characteristics but can work on higher speeds.
 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6ba271be055bfcb2836e50db281d63836f36a8e7.png


2. Missions

There have been added two new sets of missions: Exploration and Mastering for you to profound your angling skills and fully enjoy professional fishing. 
Explore every part of the proposed rivers, lakes and other bodies of water. Combining any fishing equipment and gear available to you, assemble a complete collection of fish species available for fishing and get the title of an explorer of each of the available places!
Use your skills to catch  Bass, Pikes, Trouts, Salmons, Catfish, Carps, and other ones that cause envy because of their size and power of opponents, and who often find themselves too tough for most anglers!

Show off your expert angling skills by masterfully comply tasks!


3. New lures added: try fishing with Jerkbaits and three type of Minnows - Deep Runner, Hunched Runner and Triple Runner

4. Changed access levels for Emerald and Rocky Lake. Now small mounting Rocky Lake unlocking on Level 5. Emerald Lake with rental motorboat unlocking on Level 8. Some tackles and lures also change access level.

5. Fish Float biting behavior improved. Various unique portraits of behavior added for different fish species 

6. UI improvements

7. Added Traditional Chinese localization

8. Сomplex bugfix

9.Don’t miss the new Motorboat Packs: Metalhead Motorboat Pack and  Daredevil Motorboat Pack  with 15% OFF!

2. Akhtuba River unlocked

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/92806c541335c4f5aaad61b13674f27b137a132d.png

Akhtuba river is one of the most interesting angling destinations of the country. With its diverse structure, varying depths and currents, Akhtuba River attracts anglers, eager to explore this waterway’s countless fish species

Сhaika Creek 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/afb68b2f287076a32b095e33a392974f984ced06.jpg

-  Locals call Chaika, because of the name of an old abandoned camping site nearby, with shabby wooden houses standing since the days of USSR. Separated from the wide and moderately paced waterway by a small island, these narrow waters have a totally different dynamic with much faster current and a notably different fishing experience that comes with. 

Nevertheless, the little river armlet is swarming with a large variety of different fish: from Caspian Roach and Common Bream to Zander, Asp and Wels Catfish. 

Resting Waters 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9f9d67b4296f9a5ecccb2a733e47033b3714a77f.jpg

- Densely covered with lotuses and lily pads, it seems as if this still little lake is an aquatic pit-stop, where the hurrying current of Akhtuba River flows to fall into a tranquil slumber when tired from its incessant movement. 
The lake’s calm aquatic depth hides a plentiful array of underwater inhabitants for an angler to hunt on: Blue Bream, Volga Pikeperch, Ide, European Carp, Chub and Northern Pike just to list a few. 

Wide as the Russian Soul 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b837298326ba1a583791ccb6f97f13ef89c73991.jpg

- This beautiful fishing spot is situated on one of the vast and most spacious parts of the Akhtuba River. The broad open area surrounding this lovely riverside beach greets the traveler’s eyes with gradually sloping sandy shores overlooking a somewhat abrupt and cliffy opposite bank. 

 Enjoy this broad open space, as you indulge in catching Asp, Caspian Roach, Tench, Zeige, Silver Bream, Zander and many other fish inhabiting. 

All Hail the Pioneers 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/23c523e4514bdb7097439a34935ac1ca878dc2a7.jpg

- Further upstream, in the higher reaches of Akhtuba River, you will discover a lovely steak of a long-forgotten desolate beach that once belonged to an old summer camp for young and daring Soviet pioneers. 

Ah, what an ambient place to spend the day out fishing for Zander, Northern Pike, Asp, and Wels Catfish.


3. Akhtuba's competitions included:
Roach Rider
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ec3d506ccfa0b0e45396f6b4e0f73dbe199ccf7b.png
Welcome to the aquatic splendor of the Russian Ahtuba River! It is here that you will be competing with other anglers in an epic float fishing showdown for the title of the Roach Rider! Simply hunt for all species of Roach using only float tackle and score points depending on the size of your catch! The winner will be determined by the maximum total score at the end of the competition.

Party of Five
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9b3135ebb186e4e4cb9a203c36dc385fc6a134b8.png
Welcome to the Party of Five - Pike fishing competition! Hunt for the biggest Northern Pike on the Ahtuba River amidst the Russian wilderness in this epic spinning competitive even! The Party of Five winners will be determined by the total weight of 5 biggest Northern Pike on the stringer to the end of the competition.

Ide, Huuuge Ide
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ca8cbf2b383838f06251377351dce82f1d5a4942.png
Are you up for catching one of the most favorite game fish among hardcore Russian anglers? Then head on over to the wild Ahtuba River and compete with other anglers in catching all form and sizes of Ide to win by scoring the most points for having the biggest total weight of all the Ide in your Keepnet by the end of the competition!


4. Bottom Power Pack
Bottom Power Pack is a complete all-you-need bottom tackle set with FOUR awesome rod’n’reel combos, a full selection of all the terminal tackle, feeder baits, chum, attractants and other bottom fishing equipment along with 7-DAY Pond Passes and Advanced Licenses for ALL 5 European Waterways!
