notes.title: Fishing Planet 2.0: Euro Update Patch Note
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/52ba58259f2939717c11dafa76c3ece66b0d5103.png
Hey, dear friends!  We are happy to present you an awesome update full of new cool features and amazing new content!

New region added - global map is now a globe
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6fffcb2b55ce392f4f7ca2a83f0ff47a1affdb5d.jpg
We’re finally adding a completely new region of the world to Fishing Planet - Europe! Now you’ll be able to enjoy fishing on new European waterways, complete with their own unique vibe, scenic surroundings, beautiful nature and all the realistic details inherent to the region!
The global map is now represented as a 3D globe.

Five new waterways
The first iteration of the new waterways includes 5 new rivers and lakes of the European region.﻿﻿
small and charming Lesni Vila pond of the Czech Republic
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/71c8372f0c3ee00b215423b7ae5835c71b06bd7d.jpg

exquisitely Italian and picturesque Tiber, third-longest river in Italy

big and beautiful Sander Baggersee Lake in Germany
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ccee9c1e5eab186d6aaa484d26e1962f7769acb5.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/164af82c0865bc88da0c7f132ef41b03cfa22962.jpg

Akhtuba River in Russia which will be unlocked in 2 weeks

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/76458a444a1a3fc3143826f6588d9a4316582e63.jpg


37 NEW Fish Species for you to catch! Including:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3ef14f93d2f78eb9d728035b316fa72410bb7d96.png Bream,  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8da171ca6b6d70ce5fff17979403c840fba4d569.png Tench, https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/81b443bdd41b6e01d96d2bdd2aa12da749ecfad3.png Roach,  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7be848d0f917386b79f2e40695b1c9546823573a.png Zander, https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/66a0d1f7cc603e4c6f9a4db5a0c35be263717e39.png Crucian Carp, https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/865793799bdd9f7f4643058a7bd2271510e2ce99.png Ide,
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7362f4d2eff24128ab4af435b1ce9068eaa8f249.png Asp, https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/aeeff1a1c5398734196e8d1ee2a9513d2d523645.png European Eel,  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8313dd7e4e9cc414a5a8851af20f8287c008c8a3.png Grayling,     https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6c6c139241668f518fa9fc5d260df629c4f13b61.png Marble Trout,   https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1cd86eae7cb59b7816bc58eaf6fe89535d4ca31d.png Barbel,   https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/59e41dcf4a970be9444969a915dff03cae04d194.png Round Goby,  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5e6ec2058b4ed97a3671529c11fd916a7f29d9e7.png Mirror Carp   and  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9018c7ab5bdfa9ca8c92c5dfe7821705e367bb1d.png Leather Carp  and dozens more!

This update also includes few fish giants that will get on nerves of even hardcore anglers. No one can remain indifferent in the face of 60 kg Wels Catfish and Beluga. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0af5f2976bc4914d327aa3041c4b5bb2145ce612.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6666fda82b0a0e5c4c741de2d5a48fd1b507e64c.png

New fish generation system and AI 
We have revised and reworked the fish generation system and AI to make it more realistic:
Less specific fish distribution range.
More flexible bite charts
Codependency within the fish ecosystem in the waterway.
Support of the movement of fish schools.
Consideration of  interrelation between different species of coarse fish.
More complex dependency of bites on the weather conditions.
Water temperature indicator added
Effect of chum on fish bites.
At the moment, this new system is functioning only on the newly added waterways, but will be implemented on all existing fishing destinations in the nearest future.

Bottom fishing and Feeder fishing

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b8130f816f1fc0fdf46038d0aa47397a57423720.jpg
We have added bottom fishing, including feeder fishing, to the game to enrich your angling experience.

You can catch fish by holding the rod in hand or use special rod stands that will let you make multiple casts using a number of rods simultaneously. The rod’s flexible quiver tip swill show even a slight fish bite, while using an alarm bell is a sure way no to miss it.

Fishing with feeder tackle will work almost anywhere, but this method is most popular in Europe, where there the “white”, no-predatory fish are more abundant. Crucian Carp, Bream, Tench, Common Carp, Common Barbel and many other related species are you most likely catch when feeder fishing!


Fish feeding and chum

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4d4f110ecf7ba21528bf15dd7c24da73e1708295.jpg

Another long awaited feature coming in this update is fish feeding and chums!

How Feeding works: feeding implies “providing food” for a certain areas of a waterway to attract  fish and keep them in that area. You just load some chum into the feeder and cast it to the desired spots. Once in the water, the chum begins to spread from the feeder over time, creating feed areas that attract fish. To maintain the high density feed area it’s always a good idea to make repeated casts in the same spot once in a while.

Consider that various factors like the water temperature, flow direction and speed as well as the chum composition and many others affect feed area to create realistic feel of the process.

Making your own chum
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/550f5a90f64f2239a4b9746239a0fd14fbf0982a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a6383bb7ca3c7812f663193ffd3016e01ccd97d3.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ab6b9bde9d1066ceb1cf0ac5a095daba60b138b4.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/66fad027dbb9faa6897a5365d8db09454358055c.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7c819e1a31cf21eeb58a5c0b065ebc82466d1571.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/78aa698b352a1b88a9a0c002c0828b86fb141450.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/be48da3f9ab56ab770b44106402b991acc36f78d.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5cc73369897dd777f5a9d5381b76e6e9fb38fd98.png
Basic Mixing: you just add water to a groundbait of your choice and literally create a basic mix with a single click
Advanced Mixing: combine various ingredients (groundbait , different chum aromas and some particles)  in high precision proportions to create unique recipe that will fit your needs

Keep in mind: the right chum, when used in the right places and conditions will not only increase your fish bites, but will attract more diverse and rare fish to the feed area.
There is a separate Chum slot in the inventory for all the chum ingredients: groundbaits, different chum aromas and some particles. Also you can save the recipe for all mixed chums.

Multirods support
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d6ef0002717c7debe5b4e64adacf3f682da317ef.png
The coolest thing about bottom fishing is the possibility of using different rods simultaneously!
From now on, you’ll no longer need to constantly switch between rods and  baits, making the frustrating choice of what fish to catch first and what tackle to use. The multi-rod function will double your chances of a catch and let you enjoy a variety of fish hunting options!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/82e7f27ce74a80bc0d9aef8f6a986044d631ad84.jpg
We have added  new fishing equipment - the Rod Stands, that will let you catch fish using multiple rods at the same time! In this update we added 10+ different kinds of Rod Stands, that mostly differ by bite alarms and their rod capacity, being capable of holding from 1 to 4 rods each. Please note, you can take only one type of rod stands to  the waterway.

Bottom Fishing Tackle
A lot of new tackle has been added to the game for you fully enjoy new types of fishing. This includes: bottom rods, feeder rods, new reels, line leaders, open and closed feeder, bells, sinkers and new small hooks, new strong lines (mono, fluoro and braid), new super heavy casting rods and reels.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ad3c69161b7ac7c603103ddc7999600be8304cb6.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1de4c259e982c3ae9788754076ba1f953521f625.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5fa8924068112591d0dbaf37fc42070c8390de1a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/19ea2f14433eeed79fa3235383ca565a912a00d6.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/da1c1c549ea0a3bf06cdc79e5259c1ec7430524d.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/be523eca9767eb08f73750a0bf76de28a697b1c1.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/38b809b30a6af65d23e92035ebaa49a5fdc3afd8.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d96c3ba5b5e5956967e62e67a2e7e77fc6f6b524.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d7101d102e88aa7759b46b2ae33fdb49ef2e4afb.png

Welcome new Feeder Dream Pack
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cb831642b009fd138e0a694a8a814c74ea804bc1.jpg

Feeder Dream Pack is every feeder angler’s must-have tackle set for an incredibly immersive feeder fishing experience! You get THREE powerful rod’n’reel combos, a full selection of all the terminal tackle, feeder baits, chum, attractants and other equipment along with weekly Pond Passes and Advanced Licenses for the top-3 European feeder fishing destinations!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/730619/

Tackle Setup updated
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c34fc87ab13be113fd987bb4f0eb8bf9312f6330.jpg

Now you can assemble bottom fishing and feeder setup in addition to existing spinning and float setups. Also, note that rod setup and character outfit setup are now done in different tabs.

New Competitions 
We have added new competitions on all of the new waterways.
Lesni Villa: 
Catch em' all
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ba3b8314300e22a8f8a78eed75fc10a422847a2f.png

Tiber: 
Gentle Barbel,

Spin the Salmon,

One of us, Two of Asp

Zeekanaal: 
Zander Zeek Differences,

Sander Baggersee: 
Dream Bream Hunt,
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1e26c7257226ae1b9687ea89e2d22a58bd89655b.png
Big HeadHunters,

Danger in the grass,
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9f8fcea16ae3651fcc0ec0ffd14c1befd99c2b18.png
Teenies in the night.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b726c0fa252054d3b3454fc2cd84d2107752c1b4.png
New Achievements
Make sure to complete the following new achievements on the new and existing waterways to get some cool rewards:
Lesni Vila Watcher,
Zeekanaal Buccaneer,
Tiber Wayfarer
Sander Baggersee Camper,
Lesni Vila Refiner,
Zeekanaal Purifier,
Tiber Junk Scavenger,
Sander Baggersee Cleaner,
Decontaminator,
All you need is lure,
Holy Float, Bream Master,
Predator Carp Master,
Sturgeon Master,
Roach Master,
Lesni Villa Idol,
Zeekanaal Top Dog,
Tiber Honcho,
Sander Baggersee Knight,
Lone Star Cleaner,
Mudwater Junk Collector,
Emerald Junk Catcher,
Rocky Lake Cleanser,
Neherrin Eco Friend,
Falcon Junk Hunter,
Everglades Sweeper,
White Moose Janitor,
Quanchkin Junker,
Saint-Croix Purifier,
San Joaquin Cleanser,
Kaniq Creek Sanitizer,
Lesni Vila Refiner,
Zeekanaal Purifier.

Level Cap changed
Level Cap has been raised from 40 to 50. Ranks XP requirements changed.
XP points have been divided into two parts: Level XP points and Rank XP points. All Rank XP points have been separated from Level XP and frozen together with the ranks. You can continue earning them once you reach new level cap of level 50.
On the Leaderboard you can now see both Level and Rank, XP points are summarized to determine player's position on it. You can check your Rank XP in the updated Profile Tab.


New level XP requirements and waterways rebalance
Due to addition of the new waterways, XP requirements between levels have been changed and all waterways balance has been revised. Travel cost has been reduced for some of the existing waterways.

Miscellaneous:
Alaska has been nerfed - aligned with the new level system
New HUD indicators (chum, bottom type, quiver tip)
Water temperature indicator added
Updated UI
Inventory and local map optimization

notes.notes:
Hey dear anglers,

if you’re keeping track of the posts in our Dev Diaries, you might already know that aside from introducing bottom fishing and new European waterways, our team is working hard on adding Missions to your Fishing Planet experience!

In this release we are happy to present you the 1st iteration of the Missions update - Tutorial Missions.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/eb97b7067dfc7a7ce688548491340401dce996cd.jpg

These missions are available to all players, and while they were specifically created to enrich and make the learning process more efficient for the less experienced folks, many of them will be quite useful even for the more proficient anglers. After all, Tutorial Missions are based on tasks that help you get a deeper understanding of the game as well as apply logic to choosing the best and most appropriate tackle and baits. This means, no matter how good you think you are, there still might be some cool features you overlooked!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5ae42ce947cd0076709acd8178255b7bb2b72512.jpg

Tutorial Mission are comprised of a number of tasks accompanied by hints and will be available as you progress all throughout the game.
There is a special Missions tab, where you can see the list of completed missions as well as the description and progress status of the current one. If you choose to track your current mission, all related hints and tasks will be showing up as you play the game. Or you can simply untrack your Mission to turn off the hints and mission widget.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b52f34e350f5a75159e4b85f824c5978cdf4aeda.jpg

Missions are a new addition to your overall gaming experience that can be both fun and useful, but they are optional, and whether to complete them or not is entirely up to you! However, we do hope that you’ll use this opportunity to sharpen your perspective, learn cool new things and get a better understanding of the game as you explore the Fishing Planet world with Missions and, of course, get rewards for completing them!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0885fe694d8d5618c09523fd056e8bee2183ab1d.jpg

The next iteration will include more complex missions for more experienced players of average or high proficiency levels and will be aimed at exploring the waterways and mastering your fishing skills. These tasks will require a lot of effort and skill on your part, but with greater rewards to match the sweat and tears you put in! Also, the next iteration of mission will allow you to catch a new special fish that is not available in ordinary gameplay!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cd6d922ed3f7044659b95212dcfe91b2c0aaef2e.jpg

Besides missions, Patch 1.3.2. will bring you:


new challenge: the Barbless Master
Level XP requirements changed to be in sync with new and upcoming missions.
updated local and global map UI
updated game UI
controller improvements
new sound effects
more menu music

notes.title: Major Spring Update. Patch note 1.2.0.
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Happy to announce that a Major Update has arrived with cool new features and improvements, some of which you’ve been waiting a very long time for! So here’s a full overview of this update’s essential points, covering the new features as well as the redesign of some existing functions and giving insight on how it all works:

Navigation: depth map and markers. 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/97918805bbd3888390c9f1786d9847103a0e099e.png
We added a navigation tablet showing a waterway map that you can use without leaving your fishing spot by simply pressing the [М] button! This map will show detailed info on the bottom shape and depth of the initial waterway (Lone Star) as well as provide a general description for the bottom terrain of other rivers and lakes. Players will be able to explore a detailed depth map for other waterways as well as get information about underwater structures and fish using fish finders that will be added to the game in the nearest future. Not only does this map make navigation easier, but it also allows you to leave Marks to highlight your latest fishing spots and add a corresponding description, as well as randomly mark places on the water surface with special Marker Buoys. But what’s even cooler is that you can share your Markers with friends!

Photo Mode
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c9096621e7662b7a01f5a154ef6775e06db47b48.jpg
Now you can capture and share your moments of triumph with others by taking beautiful photos of yourself holding that trophy catch from different angles! Just press the [P] button while you are still holding the fish and adjust the screen angle to your liking. You can also choose whether or not you want the fish stats to be displayed on your photo. You can make such screenshot of your catch within the Steam interface, by simply pressing F12. 
At this moment, Photo Mode is available only for bank fishing, but we’ll be adding this function for boat fishing a bit later as well.

Tackle Templates and Setups
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e9a57179eeca4cfd07824f3bcb592e5fa5563c3f.png
Templates for your favorite tackle combos are finally here! Simply select a free slot in the Templates Menu to save the your current tackle set-up and reassemble it whenever you need with just one click! And you can even share your set-up Templates with friends!

Limited Home Storage and Inventory Expansion
Yep, guys. Now that we’re introducing a true-to-life limited Home Storage, you’re gonna have to manage your space by getting rid of excess junk that you’re used to carrying around! But for those who still insist on more storage space, we’re adding a new option of Storage Boxes for inventory expansion that you can get as part of DLCs or from the in-game Store under the new SERVICES tab. Later on, you’ll also be able to get Storage Boxes as prizes for various in-game activities.

Lure Buoyancy Fixed
Let’s look at the two main problems regarding lure buoyancy that existed up until now, and how we fixed them, in this simple BEFORE/AFTER overview:
PROBLEM 1: The time it took lures to sink to the bottom.
BEFORE: All lures regardless of their weight would sink at identical speed. Be it a 4-gram spinner or a 56 gram bass jig, they’d go down the same.
AFTER: Now, just like in real life, a lure’s WEIGHT directly affects how fast it sinks. So now, it'll take more time for a light lure to go down than for a heavier one.
PROBLEM 2: How the lures parted from the bottom on slow retrieves.
BEFORE: Some lures would hardly take off the bottom when you made a retrieve using the first or second reeling speed. This would happen regardless of the lure’s weight. Heavy or light - they all behaved the same when you were making a retrieve, which of course wasn’t very realistic.
AFTER: Now, most of the lures will be showing some action even at the slowest retrieve speed, with the lighter lures lifting off the bottom and having more buoyancy than the heavier ones. Awesome, right?

New Physics
Namely:
1) fishing line made more rigid 
2) lure hydrodynamics improved
3) improved collision rendering 
4) line tension and rod tip action improved upon lure hitting the bottom 
5) effect of wind on the lure
6) wind direction indicators and Cardinal Directions added
Now you know where True North is and which way the wind is blowing

New sounds
An extensive reworking of background sounds and the sound of wind added.

New Challenge for exploring added at every waterway
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1c46f6b8f2bc4c7c52530cce1c569ea56ac97133.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2a63a2f5dcc083d13a734048b382d995a9eafc5c.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0c0b4ea155cb043942fbb46b2457362ee0049916.png
Enjoy exploring the game's waterways and their picturesque premises for a certain number of days in a row to complete all three stages of each challenge.

Changes to rule settings of competitions
We fine-tuned the rules for all competitions based on the maximum total fish weight in your Keepnet: Cheesy Cat, Yellow Perch Goldrush, Fly like a Butterfly Swim like a Bass, Sturgeon in the Dark, Big Red Fish. As of now, the size of your Keepnet no longer affects the result and all fish count, including the ones you let go.

Convenient Support Form
We added info on how to reach us, as well as a convenient support contact form directly from the game! You can access this new function from the Support tab in the Settings menu. 
In the future, we’ll make it possible to attach a screenshot to your support message. 
Please keep in mind, that the Support team’s reply will be sent to the email address you used upon registration. You can verify it in the Profile tab of the Settings menu.

We have added the ability to turn Flashlights on and off using "J". However, you can connect this function to any other hotkey in the game settings.

Chinese Language added! 
Ni hao and welcome, our dear Chinese-speaking friends!

As you can see, this is one extensive update! We hope you enjoy the new features and improvements...and tight lines

notes.title: The Dev Diaries: What’s coming in the new update?
notes.notes:
Hey guys! We get a lot of questions from you regarding our future plans for the game and what we’re currently working on. Well...we’re happy to tell you that our team is already getting bigger, which means that now we can introduce even more cool features and improvements in the nearest time. So today we’ll give you some inside scoop on the newest features that are being added to the game in test mode as we speak! 

It only seems right to mention that we often draw our inspiration for the new features from your letters, guys. 
Many of you kept asking for a Navigation functionality  to be added - and voila, here it is!
Ever since kayaks were introduced, you can catch fish all over the waterway. This, however, made it a bit difficult to remember the places for best biting. And that’s why we’re adding a couple of features to ease your navigation and let you keep track of all your favorite fishing spots!

-Depth Map. Every location in the game will now have its own unique depth map, so that you can know the bottom terrain and decide where to look or the fish you’re after. 

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/923671396603828725/8CF898BAD105FF45463D84EBEDC8F4AF6364769A/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside%7C1024%3A573&composite-to=*,*%7C1024%3A573&background-color=black 
-Markers. Now you can mark your favorite fishing spots right on the map! But that’s not all. This function allows you to add a description for every Marker, noting what kinds of fish you caught there, what tackle you used and most importantly  you will share your Markers with Friends in the future! 

Buoyancy improvements.
 
Yep, we made quite a few changes here!
Up until now, all lures regardless of their weight would sink at identical speed. Be it a 4-gram spinner or a 56 gram bass jig, they’d go down the same. Not anymore!
From now on, just like in real life, a lure’s WEIGHT directly affects how fast it sinks. So now, it’ll take almost 20 seconds for a 4-gram spinner to go down to a depth of 5 meters, whereas a bass jig of 56 grams will plummet in just 5 seconds! 

Remember how frustrating it was when you couldn’t even get some lures off the bottom when making a retrieve at first or second speed? And this would happen regardless of the lure’s weight. Heavy or light - they all behaved the same when you were making a retrieve, which of course wasn’t very realistic.
But now, most of the lures will be showing some action even at the slowest retrieve speed, with the lighter lures lifting off the bottom and having more buoyancy than the heavier ones. Awesome, right?:)

Tackle Setup Templates
We’re introducing the setup templates to make it easier for you to organise all the different tackle you use depending on the waterway, the fish or a certain competitive event. Those of you who collected copious amounts of different objects overtime will find this feature particularly useful! Now you can use personalized templates to restore and assemble the needed tackle setup with just one click of a button, without having to filter through your inventory in tedious attempts to find the necessary objects, and so - spend more time actually FISHING!;) 
 
Oh yeah, there’s one more feature we’d like to highlight: the Photomode!


https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/923671396603846185/D34263BF4E6067FF871F257B033C973220DC009B/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside%7C1024%3A576&composite-to=*,*%7C1024%3A576&background-color=black

How often did you find yourself wishing you could save your triumphant catch moments - after all the hard planning, timing, and preparations you put into it? But there was no way to capture it!
Well, that’s about to change! Now you can take beautiful photographs of yourself holding up that Trophy catch at different angles. And then - you can send the pictures to your Friends!  Share your joys and triumphs with the world! 

Well, that’s a quick overview of the new patch that’s coming your way;)
All these cool new features will be added real soon...so keep track of our updates!

And yes, we are always eager to hear your thoughts on how to make the Fishing Planet experience more comfortable and fun! 
So if you have more ideas about improving the boat navigation functionality or making the shore fishing more convenient - let us know!

It only seems right to mention that we often draw our inspiration for the new features from your letters, guys. 
Many of you kept asking for a Navigation functionality  to be added - and voila, here it is!
Ever since kayaks were introduced, you can catch fish all over the waterway. This, however, made it a bit difficult to remember the places for best biting. And that’s why we’re adding a couple of features to ease your navigation and let you keep track of all your favorite fishing spots!

-Depth Map. Every location in the game will now have its own unique depth map, so that you can know the bottom terrain and decide where to look or the fish you’re after. 

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/923671396603828725/8CF898BAD105FF45463D84EBEDC8F4AF6364769A/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside%7C1024%3A573&composite-to=*,*%7C1024%3A573&background-color=black 
-Markers. Now you can mark your favorite fishing spots right on the map! But that’s not all. This function allows you to add a description for every Marker, noting what kinds of fish you caught there, what tackle you used and most importantly  you will share your Markers with Friends in the future! 

Buoyancy improvements.
 
Yep, we made quite a few changes here!
Up until now, all lures regardless of their weight would sink at identical speed. Be it a 4-gram spinner or a 56 gram bass jig, they’d go down the same. Not anymore!
From now on, just like in real life, a lure’s WEIGHT directly affects how fast it sinks. So now, it’ll take almost 20 seconds for a 4-gram spinner to go down to a depth of 5 meters, whereas a bass jig of 56 grams will plummet in just 5 seconds! 

Remember how frustrating it was when you couldn’t even get some lures off the bottom when making a retrieve at first or second speed? And this would happen regardless of the lure’s weight. Heavy or light - they all behaved the same when you were making a retrieve, which of course wasn’t very realistic.
But now, most of the lures will be showing some action even at the slowest retrieve speed, with the lighter lures lifting off the bottom and having more buoyancy than the heavier ones. Awesome, right?:)

Tackle Setup Templates
We’re introducing the setup templates to make it easier for you to organise all the different tackle you use depending on the waterway, the fish or a certain competitive event. Those of you who collected copious amounts of different objects overtime will find this feature particularly useful! Now you can use personalized templates to restore and assemble the needed tackle setup with just one click of a button, without having to filter through your inventory in tedious attempts to find the necessary objects, and so - spend more time actually FISHING!;) 
 
Oh yeah, there’s one more feature we’d like to highlight: the Photomode!


https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/923671396603846185/D34263BF4E6067FF871F257B033C973220DC009B/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside%7C1024%3A576&composite-to=*,*%7C1024%3A576&background-color=black

How often did you find yourself wishing you could save your triumphant catch moments - after all the hard planning, timing, and preparations you put into it? But there was no way to capture it!
Well, that’s about to change! Now you can take beautiful photographs of yourself holding up that Trophy catch at different angles. And then - you can send the pictures to your Friends!  Share your joys and triumphs with the world! 

Well, that’s a quick overview of the new patch that’s coming your way;)
All these cool new features will be added real soon...so keep track of our updates!

And yes, we are always eager to hear your thoughts on how to make the Fishing Planet experience more comfortable and fun! 
So if you have more ideas about improving the boat navigation functionality or making the shore fishing more convenient - let us know!

Boat fishing is here! Are you ready?! Update 1.1.0.
notes.notes:

Kayaks are available for rent on waterways or you can purchase your own from the new Kayaks Adventure Pack! 

You can take a kayak right now and head boat fishing on either of these 5 waterways: 

Emerald
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/da0a7b4d66bd887e2a0270a76857a5c1017a5d2a.jpg

Falcon
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cd672b65e1d6d4974bdcb3cbbeee4fcba6e1742c.jpg

White Moose Lake 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7ca078b66a3cd03255ebf24da1130c378c418812.jpg

Lake Saint Croix
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8da13be5dfc391611e91ad89a3bf2270eb5b81d7.jpg

San Joaquin Delta 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/44f2bde07281bf2614fedec736a6c3bbadb6b2bd.jpg


Boat pins have been added on local maps, so you know where kayaks are on the waterways.

Another cool thing that awaits you is lots of new water access points on Emerald Lake, White Moose Lakes, Saint Croix and San Joaquin! This means a fresh look at your favorite waterways and new places to explore and set off with your kayak from!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/137215baaaec63bbebaed1d208df663c8ec041f4.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/73dc1cb3762935e0dcd8e03541f75942b4532948.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/00c6fd45db2dd07d1feb39abb036815a97e11ed0.jpg

Moreover, we added THREE new fish species! Now you can catch:  
Sauger on Emerald Lake, 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e12be0628c10a59ced99ed10e1744b760e332e8e.png

Clear Muskie on Saint Croix,
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/265c88f6f022006ca8696d5cbd93edc69ba5b7f1.png

Lake Whitefish on White Moose Lake! 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/355ab1d52ead8ba12be56b54b07131ea98eef8a9.png

So go ahead and rent a kayak - already available for boat fishing on one of the 5 fishing destinations! 

Or how about buying one of your own? Better yet, become a proud owner of THREE fantastic kayaks, each with its own unique characteristics - all in the new Kayaks Adventure Pack, now available at 15% discount!

Kayaks Adventure Pack also includes cool stuff like Credits, BaitCoins, and most importantly - 30 days of Premium Account, 30-day Pond Passes and monthly Advanced Licenses to all the best boat fishing destinations, including Saint Croix, Emerald, Falcon and White Moose Lakes as well as San Joaquin Delta!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/591986/

One more pleasant update is that travel cost has been decreased for the following lakes: Emerald, Rocky, Quanchkin and San Joaquin Delta.

This is just a short summary to tell you about what’s coming your way!:) 

While you enjoy Kayaks, we’ll continue working on adding more types of boats to the game: Zodiac boats, bass boats and other motor boats. We’ll also be expanding the geography of our waterways for boat fishing. 

Tight lines and stay tuned!

notes.title: Topwater & Nightfishing Update (v.1.0.0 Patch note)
notes.notes:
Hey there, angling community!

We prepared an awesome update with amazing new features, including TOPWATER and  NIGHTFISHING, as well as new line and lure physics!

Main highlights

Topwater : 
We created new topwater fishing lures: Walkers, Poppers and Frogs.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ec0249835ef0124dbb4cc0ebd4291669b1aa765a.png
Two new retrieves added: Popping and Walking.
Substantial changes to line and lure physics.

Night Fishing:
Changes to fishing Licenses: Night Fishing is permitted only with Advanced Licenses.
Changes made to the shift between fishing days: your catch in the fishkeeper is sold at 5 a.m. every next morning. This means you can keep fishing all night long!
New fish activity charts for nighttime added.
New tackle for fishing in the dark: rods with fluorescent tips, that let you see the fish bite even in total darkness!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/de422432472359b24b7d08f5ba76da4cfac27b98.png
We also added holographic lures of different weights snd sizes: luminescent Cranks and glow in the dark soft lures: Craws, Worms and Shads.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4088fb5f5fc80dce547339746f0fcf9c377710e7.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2b96760221d6231fe42d55b345e8b6a150136050.png
A wider selection of glow-in-the-dark floats: now slim and pear-shaped floats added.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c93b992a5a7702791360bfaebb3702053a7a23f6.png
New unique fishing cap with flashlight that you can get for completing the new "Night Shift" challenge.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ce19e5250e024a73f18e4225b48b16d4c6595381.png

Miscellaneous
New animation for underwater lure indicator. 
New Ardix match rod and LineGlider spinning reel added.
Level requirement changes made for Brutus rods as well as reels of Hornet Swarm and Espira DoublePunch series.
Retrieves system has been reworked.
Last selected rod now is saved.
Pitching flag for each floating rod will be saved during pond session as well.
 Last selected in inventory rod will be automatically taken in game when you leave inventory
Auto selecting first equipped rod when last used was disassembled

Topwater Midnight Pack
No fishfight is more visual and powerful than a proper topwater battle! And nothing compares in its atmosphere to a night hunt! Both spectacular and challenging in their beauty, topwater and night fishing are a complex art that equally requires sharp skill and the right tools! That’s why we created the TOPWATER MIDNIGHT PACK - for all anglers who can handle the eye-popping action and raw emotion of confronting your scaly enemy face-to-face and bring in the catch in the darkest hours!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/591981/

notes.title: FISHING PLANET GOES FROM BETA TO FULL RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Dear friends! 

It’s been 2 long years full of fun and exciting adventures within our Fishing Planet world...and now we are happy to announce that we're going from Early Access to our official STEAM RELEASE! You’ve seen us grow, you’ve supported us and it's fair to say that you played a huge part in creation of the whole virtual fishing ecosystem! 

We’re happy that our fishing community keeps growing and cherish every one of our players, working hard to make you guy happy and introduce as many new and interesting features as our small team can, at this stage.  

And so, we prepared an awesome new update with amazing new features, including NIGHT and TOPWATER fishing, which will be available in a few days!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7581a1200aa59cac249299827a18f2d27e7abac5.jpg

notes.title: Patch note 0.8.4
notes.notes:
Hey dear anglers,

Here is patch note for 0.8.4

 Main highlights 

"Fourth of July" event in honor of Independence day , that includes various gameplay activities:

Ability to catch historical tagged fish and to get achievements and rewards for it (new historical fish has been added).
Ability to get tackle rewards and fireworks for everyday flag-raising on the event locations.
Ability to launch fireworks on all event locations.

The event takes place from 6/27/2017 till 7/10/2017.
The annual Trout sportfishing tournament  - Independence Trout Open will be held as part of the event.

 New Tournament -  Independence Trout Open 

Tournament held on Colorado’s Rocky Lake, Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan, Alberta’s White Moose Lake, Falcon Lake in Oregon.
Target fish - Trout.
Dates: 7/04 - 7/09, Registration begins 7/03/2017.
Schedule details available in-game!

Welcome to Independence Trout Open, the annual Trout sportfishing tournament hosted by Fishing Planet in the wake of July 4th, Independence Day! This is what we’ve all been waiting for!

The Trout you catch might be virtual, but the Tournament and the Championship status are as real as they get!

Register for the Independence Trout Open, pass the Qualifiers, get to the Final Round and compete against the very best to become the Independence Trout Open Champion!

First-place winner and two runner-ups get the fame, the glory and, of course, valuable prizes! But making it to the Top-10 is quite an achievement too!

This is the one sportfishing event you don’t want to miss!

 Independence Trout Open will be held July 4th through July 9th , with the Registration starting on July 3rd, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:

3rd of July - Registration for the Tournament begins.
4th of July - Qualifier 1 on Colorado’s Rocky Lake.
5th of July - Qualifier 2 on Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan.
6th of July - Qualifier 3 on Alberta’s White Moose Lake.
8th of July - Semifinal Round on Falcon Lake in Oregon. 
9th of July - the Grand Finale on Oregon’s Falcon Lake.


 DLC 

Happy 4-th of July Pack! store.steampowered.com/app/423369/


 Miscellaneous 

Multiple localization bugs fixed.
Controller navigation improved and some bugs fixed.

notes.title: Patch notes 0.8.0
notes.notes:
Gameplay
We introduced special hot keys for selecting lures/baits and rods when fishing! Use the hotkeys to bring up a floating menu of lures/baits and rods available in your backpack and quickly make your switch. 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/05958367d572651f10a060c8db760bf39c26eab9.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bf0382770d8ce3cc05a92e97bb1bc07b77b7fec7.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d3cf64e52ea93569bce08a45fc35cdc9fee845a3.jpg


This will make the process much faster and easier without distracting the player from the game.
The bait change panel is opened by pressing "Z" key(as default), while holding "Z" key you can set a new bait by scrolling the mouse wheel.
The rod change panel is opened by pressing "Q" key(as default), while holding "Q" key you can set a new rod by scrolling the mouse wheel.New mechanism and animation for predatory fish striking a float rig. Now a predator’s strike looks more aggressive and intense, making it easy to distinguish from a non-predatory fish and get prepared for a real fight!New tutorial slides added.
Miscellaneous
Some localization bugs fixed.Quanchkin Lake, Kaniq Creek and Saint-Croix optimized.New faces for 3D characters added.More sounds added and lobby music changed.Models and textures of some fish fixed.New models and animation of fish jumping from the water during the daytime activityFixed bobber size display for different modes
New Tournament - Char Charger's Open
Tournament held on Kaniq Kreek, Saint-Croix Lake and White-Moose LakeTarget fish - Chars
Dates: 17.05 - 21.05, Registration begins 16.05.2017
Schedule details available in-game!
Ah, the merry month of May! With spring in full bloom and summer closing in, recharge yourself by taking part in the unforgettable Char Charger’s Open! Held on the North America’s top Trout fishing destinations - from the cold and beautiful banks of Alaska’s Kaniq Creek, to the breathtaking Saint-Croix Lake in Michigan and the snowy Canadian White Moose Lake, this exciting event will have you competing with fellow anglers in 2 preliminary Qualifiers as well as the Semifinal and the Final Round that’ll settle the dispute of who’s the Char Champion once and for all!


17th of May - Qualifier 1 on Kaniq-Kreek River in Alaska.
18th of May - Qualifier 2 on Saint-Croix Lake in Michigan.
20th of May - Semifinal Round on the White-Moose Lake in Alberta state in Canada.
21st of May - Grand Finale on the White-Moose Lake in Alberta state in Canada.

notes.title: Update 0.7.5 Release Note. Prepare for Double XP Weekend & Crappie Valentine Сup
notes.notes:
Hello, dear angling community!

We have some hot news for you, cuz this weekend will be sizzling with action!
Prepare for the Double XP Weekend - your ultimate opportunity to go up a few Levels faster than ever! But that’s not all…
We are also disabling the CoolDown function for Time Fwd feature until Monday, which means that you can fish at any convenient time without waiting or limitations!

We’d like to tell you more about this coming VALENTINE'S DAY Update! We wanted to make this Valentine’s Day very special even for the toughest and most skeptical members of our angling community
- your ultimate opportunity to go up a few Levels faster than ever! But that’s not all…

Here are the main highlights:
First off, we’re hosting Crappie Valentine Cup, a sportfishing event to get everyone in the holiday mood this February 14th! 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c0e891779ec8569257a701ebbd555f38662b1991.png

Secondly, you’re in for a completely new and different location "Salty Delta"  on Florida’s vast Everglades 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a546a9c31fde003bca00a953b5bb82ebed8f3e44.jpg
This is beautiful delta with brackish water, where you can finally catch  Atlantic Tarpon! 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8a211445aaf95e43dec31f88f1e4f409ddd09758.png

And last, but not least is a bunch of other cool things like the new Crappie Valentine Pack with exclusive tackle and outfit.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/496439

But let’s take another moment and look closely at the upcoming Crappie Valentine Cup. 
Now you don’t have to worry about missing your Qualifier time window and can take part in the Qualifiers at your convenience within the 20 hours given for passing that particular stage.
Current Tournament results will be calculated and published every 24 hours.
Now the goal is to make it to the Top 20 players in every round, with 60 players competing in the Semifinal and 20 players battling in the Final Round.
Crappie Valentine Cup will be held Feb 14th, through Feb 19th.
Registration starting on February 13th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. 

The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:

14th of February - Qualifier 1 on Mudwater River in Missouri.
15th of February - Qualifier 2 on the beautiful Lake Rocky in the state of Colorado.
16th of February - Qualifier 3 on California’s San Joaquin Delta.
18th of February - Semifinal Round on the swampy Quanchkin Lake in Louisiana.
19th of February - the Grand Finale on Neherrin River in the fine state of North Carolina.

This Tournament’s Prize Pool:

200.000 Credits and 5.000 BaitCoins - First place
100.000 Credits and 3.000 BaitCoins - Second place
50.000 Credits and 1.000 BaitCoins - Third place
And unique equipment 

Telescopic Rod X-Series Javelin™ 700  
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1a7807402fbbf2fba4a8429f86c7537b57b03969.png
Rivertex™ CVC Victor Cap 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a8d3efd20350babdb5cb31448673c58298f1f36c.png


Additional prizes in game currencies for Winners of every Round of the Tournament.

And now a list of other changes:

New feature added - now you can use a Lip Grip - to conveniently hold and display your catch!
Different fixes including improved fishing license notifications and changes made to fishing fines
Added hints on the controller in the settings window, and local maps, inventory window
Now you can buy unlimited license with negative credits balance
Fixed wrong message about money balance
Fixed the descriptions of all the competition in Spanish
Some changes in Shiner settings
Fixed wrong place assigned in competition


This pretty much gives you an idea what to expect
Good luck to you and Happy Valentine’s Day!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.7.0 PATCH NOTES & MIGRATION MAP
notes.notes:
Features
Leveling
Introduced Level cap 40
Players can subsequently reach max level unlimited number of times.
Ranking system introduced: each time Level cap is subsequently reached, player’s rank grows by 1 and a reward is given for reaching max level.
Level XP requirements completely changed.
Level requirements for unlocking new waterways changed as follows:  
Lone Star Lake - Level 1
Mudwater River - Level 3
Emerald Lake - Level 5
Rocky Lake - Level 8
Neherrin River - Level 10
Falcon Lake - Level 14
Everglades - Level 18
White Moose Lake - Level 22
Quanchkin Lake - Level 26
Saint-Croix - Level 30
San Joaquin - Level 34
Kaniq Creek - Level 38
Fish XP calculation formula changed.
Now fish XP formula includes tackle params. When catching heavy fish with light tackle you get more and vice versa.
XP reduction for subsequently catching same kinds of fish removed.
Fish XP alterations on all waterways.
No more ХР reward for Achievements.
No more XP reward for gaining new Level.
Level requirements changed for most in-game Tackle and Equipment.

Game Economy
In-game currency changes
Credits: Standard in-game currency.
BaitCoins: New Premium Currency introduced instead of Gold. You can either buy it from the Game Store, earn for completing achievements, getting higher ranking or next Level or winning competitive events.
Gold: Completely removed from the game. All players with accumulated Gold will receive BaitCoins instead, as foreseen by the conversion procedure.

Licenses
Licensing system simplified:
Now there are only 2 kinds of Licenses - Basic and Advanced.
Basic:
Catch any fish in the pond
Must release all Trophy and Unique forms of target fish
Must keep rough (coarse) fish
Advanced:
Catch, keep or release all kinds of fish
Permanent licenses can now be acquired only with Premium currency (BaitCoins)
Penalty rules changed: inspection only takes place once, no additional inspection at the end of the day.

Traveling
Home waterway entity removed. Now all fishing trips cost the same for all players.
Cost of tackle and equipment
Price changes in the Game Store

Money for fish
No more Gold for catching fish 
Changes to amount of money for catching all fish
BaitCoins will be given along with Credits for catching rare fish

Achievements
A few BaitCoins are given as reward for completing some Achievements
New items added for completing certain Achievements that cannot be obtained in any other way
Other rewards for Achievements removed

Level gaining
Upоn gaining nеxt level, player gets a fixed amount of BaitCoins
Level gain accompanied by a showcase of newly Unlocked

Graphics and Surrounding
Dragonflies added
Lighting algorithm changed
Visual hints added to water surface - hatchlings, air bubbles, etc
Most waterways optimized

Fish
Fish and tackle physics moved to a separate thread
Fish migration within a waterway added
Tackle load calculation changed
Unique forms introduced for almost all fish species
New menu that shows all forms and species of fish within a certain waterway
New fish: Tiger Muskie
New fish: Tiger Trout
New fish: Splake
New fish: Golden Trout
New fish: Redband Trout

Game characters
3D game characters added
You can see 3D characters of other players
Modify your 3D character’s appearance
Chat messages above the 3D characters introduced
DLC items added - most items like jackets or caps can be seen on the Characters

UI
Game interface completely renewed
Controller support added
Manage your fishnet in the catch overview window
Cooldown period for the Forward Time function introduced. Cooldown time depends how far the time was forwarded
New menu that shows all forms and species of fish within a certain waterway as well as some hints as to catching these fish
Premium features
Now you can purchase a Pond Pass to one of the 6 most popular fishing destinations, that also includes an advanced license
Now DLCs include Pond Passes along with the corresponding advanced licenses
Currency conversion from BaitCoins into Credits added
FF Time cooldown period reduction
Unlock game waterways and remove level requirements for corresponding tackle
Buy permanent fishing licenses
Buy Premium Account
Premium Account gives +50% to XP and money for fish caught
Register in Competitions for free

DLC
4 new DLC Packs added, each focusing on certain target fish and containing passes to 2 waterways with corresponding licenses as well as tackle sets for target fish.

notes.title: BUGFIX AND OPTIMIZATION UPDATE COMING IN 10 MINUTES
notes.notes:
Hey there fellow anglers!

During the Alaska Anniversary update we have received a significant amount of feedback from you regarding the issues that previously stayed out of our scope.

Here goes:


We have researched the differences between the expected fish activity and the actual fish activity reported by some players based on player statistics and applied a fix to Fish AI in terms of lure and bait attractivity. The players that have previously experienced awkwardly low fish activity should see increase after the patch.
Starting, ending and canceling Competitions sometimes resulted in bugs, we have researched and fixed reported issues.
Sometimes the automated maintenance server reboot coincided with Competitions, we have ensured this would never occur again and tuned the Competitions schedule accordingly.
The great Compost Pile on the Home waterway sometimes experienced worm outages. We ensured that the pile is the land of plenty for worms.
We have applied deep optimization towards server performance which should result in higher overall sustainability of the game.

We continue our work and will share the news soon.

Tight lines!

After releasing Alaska we have received a considerable ammount of feedback about the issues with the waterway. After researching the matter we need to acknowledge that Alaska has severe issues and bugs in terms of Fish AI and physics which may cause performance issues too.

We are sorry for the inconvenience you have experienced and we assure you that in the vey idea of making an Alaskan area waterway we had a wish to deliver the celebration of fishing with plenty of fish during spawning season.

Soon we shall release fixes and address the issues with Alaska, we shall reimburse the credits you lost due to the trips with no catch and issue additional courtesy perks to you.

Thank you for being with us and sorry for letting you down.

notes.title: PREPARE FOR VIRTUAL BASS OPEN! UPDATE AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Now that we are sure that tournaments work just fine and we have fine-tuned the anti-cheat systems it is time to announce the Virtual Bass Open.

This is the Bass tournament many of you have been anxiously waiting for so long. But that's not all, folks, a mint classy DLC, UI improvements and fixes will make fishing even better.

Don't lose your chance to get some cash playing Fishing Planet!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b54d00f621e2e635b7eae98bdff887c8fda1971d.png

Virtual Bass Open

Enter the Virtual Bass Open, pass the Qualifiers, get to the Final Round and compete against the very best to become the Virtual Bass Open Champion!

First-place winner gets the fame, the glory and $1000 First Prize!
Don’t miss the most real sportfishing tournament of the virtual realm!

REGISTRATION OPENS - JULY 10th - 1 P.M. EST

Tournament Conditions:

Everyone is eligible to register and participate in the Tournament. 

All player level restrictions for visiting waterways in Tournament-related States will be temporarily lifted for all players registered in the Tournament.

Tournament registration fee covers all necessary Licenses for all the fish in the waterways of Tournament-related States. Licenses will be valid only for the duration of the Tournament for all participants regardless of their performance.
 
Tournament Rounds include: 3 Qualifiers, Semifinal and Final Round. In order to advance to the next Round, a player must make it to the Top 10 of the previous Round. 

Every round of the Tournament is held in real time, simultaneously for all players.

There are 3 Qualifying Rounds. To get to the Semifinal Round a player must make it to the Top 10 in either one of the three Qualifiers. This means you get 3 chances to make it to the Semifinal. 

If you make it to the Top 10 players in the first  Qualifier, you automatically become a participant of the Semifinal and cannot participate in the 2 remaining Qualifiers. 

All players who make it to the Top 10 of the Semifinal get to take part in the Final Round.

The three winning places of the Tournament will each get their share of the $1500 total prize money.

Tournaments are available only for individuals of age 18+


COMING SOON - A MUST-HAVE DLC that will make you look like a Pro. Fake it till you make it, right?

http://store.steampowered.com/app/496430

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d1c40a01f5346bea91490829064f1fbcfd28ee6a.png

PATCH NOTES:
A whole new tournament with real-money reward
Visual UI improvements - finally the interface gets a better look. These are just first steps and gradually Fishing Planet is going to look better and better
Gamepad inversion option added to settings menu
Force-feedback for gamepad option added to settings menu
Tournament weather functionality tweaks
Small anti-cheat enhancements

notes.title: UPDATE 0.5.0 IS AVAILABLE - PREPARE FOR TOURNAMENTS
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Anglers!

Today is the Day! We proudly present you the Patch 0.5.0 with some greatly anticipated features as well as 4th of July celebrations!  Let's see what we got here for you:

Independence Trout Open

This is a brand new sport event with real money prize pool $1500. There are some key points every participant should know:


Tournament will be held July 1st - July 5th, with a day off on July 4th between the Semifinal and Final rounds.
Tournament will have following stages: registration, qualifiers, semifinal, final. (After each round we shall hold a result verification session)
Registration begins 24 hours prior to the Qualifiers.
Top 10 players of each Qualifier go to the next stage. You may participate in all three Qualifiers until you either Qualify or the Qualification period is over.
Top 10 players of Semifinal will go the Grand Finale.
The Top 3 players will get their share of the prize money in the Grand Finale.
Tournament will be held on lakes White Moose, Saint-Croix, Rocky and Falcon. All these lakes will be decorated with Tournament banners accordingly.
This Trout fishing Tournament implies Catch&Release fishing. Only 10 fish from your Keepnet qualify. You must release extra fish once over the limit.
All players who register in the Tournament will get the necessary Licenses and have player level restrictions lifted for the waterways in Tournament-related States. Even after the player is out, he can visit these States until the Tournament ends.
Tournaments will be available only for individuals of age 18+

Good luck and have a great fun!



4th OF JULY EVENT

ON JULY 4TH ALL LEVEL LOCKS WILL BE REMOVED FOR ONE WHOLE DAY!


Tagged Fish
This Independence Day try your luck at catching truly historic fish that are over 200 years old! The story has it, that on 4th of July 1796 many young fish were released into the lakes and rivers throughout North America to honor the 20th Anniversary of USA Independence. All these fish had a special anchor tag clipped onto their fins, marked with the year and President’s George Washington’s signature! So good luck at catching these living pieces of History!

Collect them all and add your name to the event leaderboards.

And get new Independence Day achievement - win George Washington's Hat!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e48daa22779914a9517a61ab77163c378b5ea6a5.png

Lone Star Lake - Historic Spotted Bass
Mudwater - Historic White Crappie
Emerald - Historic Chain Pickerel
Rocky - Historic Cutthroat Trout
Neherrin - Historic Smallmouth Bass
Falcon - Historic Rainbow Trout
Everglades - Historic Largemouth Bass
San Joaquin - Historic Chinook Salmon
Saint-Croix - Historic Muskie

Raise the Flags!
In honor of great date the flags are raised above our waterways. Join the celebration - ignite the fireworks, interact with flags and claim some sweet random presents!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c431bcaae2453f0852e9be27fa24aca8f48746ef.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7e96b579810dc31673124f54d2cc44b08a089a65.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/718094aebe152166053a8339f0ea76b724645729.png

The flagpoles are located on every waterway present on American soil!
To interact press - [E]

notes.title: HOTFIX AND IMPROVEMENT UPDATE ON THE WAY!
notes.notes:
Fellow anglers!
No need to say that we constantly improve each and every part of our game. Competitions are no exclusion and are subject to thorough and swift improvements. Today’s patch will make things even better and the struggle for glory ever more challenging!

NOTABLE FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS:[olist]
 Scoring system adjusted to exclude odd participants from ratings (for instance, sometimes players with overall average performance and scoring points occupied top places due to scoring update issue). Some of you may now notice your ranking in previous competitions changed to a lower rating -  achieving fair play may be painful and thank you for your understanding.   

 Further fish weight distribution improvement to exclude similar results in competitions.

 Competition dynamic scoring UI improved. Feel the action and see your performance in perspective – from now on during competitions you see the Top 3 overall players, as well as your results and three players ahead and behind you.

 Server functionality for additional conditions for Competitions implemented – several more steps left to implement conditions limiting participation by level of tackle (rods, reels, lines, baits and lures). Get ready to prove your skill among equals!

[/olist]

notes.title: GO COMPETITIVE! COMPETITION UPDATE 0.4.0 AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Hey there fellow anglers!

The time has come for a long-awaited Competition update! The servers will be down for one hour and after that...


The fishing Competitions are finally here (in Beta mode)!

Fishing Planet team is proud to present Competitions as an entirely new multiplayer gaming mode. This much awaited feature will let you put your fishing skills to the test and compete against other anglers! Not to mention that it’s a great opportunity to earn some extra money! Here are some details about the Fishing Planet Competitions to answer any questions you might have:
 In-game Competitions are held on a daily basis, so everyone will get a chance to participate.

 Competitions are NOT to be confused with Tournaments. You may find the rules of some Competitions to be a bit unusual or even weird, but rest assured, we’ve put a lot of thought into every rule to ensure a fun and competitive experience! Let’s say you’re bored and tired of fishing for Bass… Well, then you could try your luck at catching the smallest Shiner!

 Along with the Competitions mode, the so-called PSR - Personal Skill Rating will be introduced to the game. PSR - is a dynamic rating of your Competition performance. Depending on your results it will either get higher or lower. That way you’ll be able to keep track of your performance on the improved Leaderboard with the newly introduced PSR rating. Tight lines!

 Everyone will get a chance to be an active Competitor! Even if your rating is low, don’t worry. There are special Competitions for low-level players.

 Right from the start we are launching 12 different and unique Competitions for you to enjoy that will encompass all waterways in all the States, except Lone Star Lake (since it is the starting Home waterway and is not meant for hosting any competitions)

 We plan on expanding the variety of Competitions by adding new ones, that’ll be even more fun and diverse! Make sure to keep track of the updates.


COMPETITION GUIDELINES: HOW TO PLAY?
Here’s an overview to highlight key points of Competition mode and explain how it works.
The much anticipated Competitions button on the upper UI panel is finally unlocked!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a1090ab242e9fba373eaefec65c42883d647a485.jpg

Upon clicking this button, the Competitive Dashboard menu will open up. Here you can conveniently select and register in any Competition that is currently available to you (if such exists atm), read the Competition overview/rules and apply as a participant.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/09e0cf588fc35c5e4320973eded83907752fd008.png

The rules can be somewhat tricky, so make sure to read them attentively!

ALL PREMIUM ACCOUNT HOLDERS MAY TAKE PART IN ANY COMPETITION FREE OF CHARGE WITHOUT PAYING REGISTRATION FEE.

You may also plan ahead your events by checking out the full timetable of all current Competitions in the Competitions Schedule menu.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e7059a4c2a1a02e507f9dedc0569fae951b9209d.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ec2d44ed75d536d212d75e1b0836a41c708f9d5c.png

Once you’ve read the rules and registered, wait for the Competition to start and head over to the corresponding location.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/687bfde3efa87e0931ac989f409cd7ff5fdb279e.jpg

Make sure that your equipment and tackle fit the corresponding Competition rules! Otherwise you will not be admitted to participate in the Competition.
Now all you have to do is FISH like there's no tomorrow!

Keep track of the Competition results.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ef5a154df57e5796a15f5c1fb03ad07200ac496c.jpg

DOMINATE FISHING PLANET!

PATCH NOTES:
 Competitions multiplayer mode now added!

 New competitive Achievements added.

 Barbless hooks and fish-friendly lures added to the in-game Store.
 
 Ultralight rods and reels now available at in-game Store.

 A new DLC with unique sports edition outfits and equipment: cap, jacket, rod case and backpack.

 All tackle that was or still is available for sale in DLCs now features the SE logo (Special Edition)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.3.0 COMING IN 30 MINUTES! BRACE YOURSELVES!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

The game-changing Update is almost here! We have put a lot of effort in delivering it and you should know - fishing is now addictive as never before. Things shall be tuned but we are sure that current update will change the way you fish!

Read the updates with attention!

Additional tackle parameters
 New parameters influencing casting mechanic
1) Rod Casting Test
2) Lure Weight 
3) Lure Windage
4) Line Thickness – visibility factor in Fish AI increased
5) Reel Type (cast reel or spin reel)
6) Line  Type (braid or mono/flur)
7) Min Cast Weight (of lure) for cast reels
New bobber params enabling unique sensitivity and lifting capacity for each bobber type

BALANCE YOUR SETUP WISELY! THE SETUP IS ALWAYS A BALANCE NOW!

HEAVY LURES CAN BREAK THIN LINE AND IF THE LINE IS STRONG ENOUGH AND YOU CAST A STONE-HEAVY LURE YOU MAY DAMAGE A LIGHT ROD.

STRONG LINE REQUIRES A STRONG REEL AND MAY SAFE YOU FROM THE INITIAL STRIKE OF A FISH BUT BREAK YOUR REEL IN THE LEAST APPROPRIATE MOMENT.

IDEAL CASTING DISTANCE DEPENDS ON PUTTING THE RIGHT LINE, LURE, ROD AND REEL. IT ALL MATTERS!

BOBBERS NOW SINK IF YOU USE A TOO HEAVY BAIT. READ BOBBER MAXFLOATWEIGHT PARAMETER.
 
Fish AI
Introduction of fish fatigue - the more tired the fish is the lower its power is and the lesser load it can create. Each species now gets tired differently, some create only several bursts of energy and then get shocked, some like smallies will fight until the very end.
Introduction of hiding spots for fish - now Fish AI can determine the underwater objects (snags, stones, holes with plants) where it can hide. If the fish determines an underwater object close to itself it shall try to escape to that place. When a fish enters such a place you can get snagged due to plants and other trash.
Detailed tuning of fish physical body parameters to simulate its movement in water when you reel it in and it resists, how the body turns in the water and how the trajectory of fish movement changes.
Fish escape due to ultra-high line tension or low line tension tuned. Do not leave your line slack - the fish may get rid of the hook.
Fish sizes/weights now vary significantly. The hook size is still a factor you need to keep in mind but the overall impact on the size of the fish you can hook and catch is now a lot less strict. You can now catch a unique using a small hook, if you manage to fight it somehow =) So don't relax it is getting a lot less predictable
Improving distribution AI and diminishing hot spots


Item durability system
Items are now separated in two groups - items that wear out due to daily use (clothing, rod cases, etc) and items that gradually wear out per each use (tackle).
The more load you put on tackle the faster it will wear out and if you exceed max loads it can break instantly.


New Load Indication
Casual angler Indicator now demonstrates which specific part of your set up is under load, letting you react and lower your rod thus projecting load on reel and not line or rod. This way you shall need to use the tackle wisely and move around with the rod with attention during the fish fight.
https://i.imgur.com/thu2jCc.gif

Pro angler Indicators a more detailed indicator for pros that fight monsters and when seconds to reaction matter (and they will, they will)
https://i.imgur.com/9jvCQWp.gif
http://i.imgur.com/ueY0Df8.png


A complete new Ultralight DLC
Now that the loads work properly you will very well consider that using UL tackle is a great option.
UNIQUELY AVAILABLE IN THE DLC
A thin almost transparent but immensley stron line, beautiful rod and reel featured in different sizes and MicroSpinner along with MicroSpoons 
http://store.steampowered.com//app/423361

Drag
Reels will now have 6, 8 or 12 drag positions thus giving you more control.
Drag setting are now distributed equally per each position, no more exponential growth
When drag works it light up on the UI


Similar fish/hook weight/size issue fix
 a game-changer  – MONSTER WILL OCCASIONALLY BITE

Ability to sell items

Line cutting window added when equipping line
Now when you equip line we give you option to choose how much line you'd like to equip. Line is now stockable anymore, equipping line means creating new piece of it.

Chat overhaul and improvement
Private chat now functional
Chat overall redesign, addition of chat settings and much more
https://i.imgur.com/Pb3QuCC.gif

Minimized chat now available - because but sometimes you just want to enjoy the beauty of nature in Fishing Planet staying connected with your friends
https://i.imgur.com/6gA9KkM.gif


Addition of Private rooms
Two types of private rooms introduced - solitude private room and a room visible to you and your friends only. (friends of your friends will not see the room, no)
http://i.imgur.com/SeOl5yo.jpg

Widening shoreline on waterways
Status - Complete
Mudwater (shoreline widened)
Neherring (fully walk-able)
Falcon (fully walk-able)
Michigan (peninsula and rights side of the map fully walk-able)


One waterway now equals one chat room
A very cool feature letting you feel that a waterway is a single seamless place

No more fixed locations – only teleport pins for your comfort
Roam free!

Settings menu overhaul and controller support
http://i.imgur.com/JJw8zXO.jpg

New Fish Species included

American Shad
http://i.imgur.com/yhsHrWS.png
Freshwater Drum
http://i.imgur.com/60V7GKm.png

Hey there Fellow Anglers!

The Holiday Season has been a real hit. More than 500.000 fireworks have been launched and about 501.000 furry trouts caught. In rough numbers that would make enough fur to produce some 14.000 Fur coats and Jackets! Wow, that's a lot! But there's even more to that - you guys have spent about 1000 in-game years having fun on the White Moose Lake.

Now, it is high time to move forward and tell you what we have been cooking while you enjoyed Canadian Vacation. And we have to tell you that we've been working hard. The list of features we shall be posting below is what we currently have under development (some features are already done).

It is too early to share any ETA's but it is going to take not less than a month to enter CBT phase for the mentioned features.

This is going to be a big leap for Fishing Planet, we are going to re-balance some things from scratch and in a good way this is going to be a different and more interesting, open and diversified game with teams and clubs letting you compete in a fair game and win some valuable prizes becoming famous worldwide as virtual pro-anglers! =)

Tight Lines!

notes.title: PREDATOR HUNTER DLC PACK SERVICE UPDATE AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
Hey!

Today we are introducing a new DLC - Predator Hunter Pack.

Predator Hunter Pack designed specially for predator hunters and anglers who do not feel like waiting to get Crankbaits and the newest rods and reels. The Pack contains a selection of tackle ideal for fishing Pike, Walleye and ready for Muskie and is designed to assure best possible experience for players who travel to Michigan and boost user progress to get there faster.

Purchasing the pack is a true steal deal as it is more than 50% cheaper than  the same items with ingame currency and it features a huge MagFin FishHut Keepnet G that allows to take 220 lb's of fish as well as a selection of gold items.

Pricing shall be announced later today.

The update features a tweak that makes the goods from the pack go to your home storage instead of messing up with your current set-up.

http://i.imgur.com/JKcLiaR.jpg?1

Package includes:
5000 CREDITS use to purchase new tackle, pay for fishing trips, repairs and any other in-game expenses. 
50 GOLD COINS use to purchase advanced fishing tackle, available only for Gold. Spend your Gold wisely! 
30-DAY PREMIUM Enjoy 30 days of Premium Status and advance your game progress by getting a 50% boost to Experience earned for every fish you catch!

RODS ‘N REELS fantastic Spinning combos for Pike and Walleye fishing:

Rods: 
Rivertex Thora 9' 6"
Rivertex GalaxyCast 8' 6"
Reels: 
RIVERTEX Exterminator 4500		
RIVERTEX  VorteX 4000		
 
TERMINAL TACKLE:
A selection of predatory fish tackle that will ensure you enjoy fighting even with Muskie!

CRANKBAITS: Crawfish, Perch, Rainbow, White&Blue and Lemon patterns
LURES: Lemon Tiger and Red Tiger Medium spoons

Softbaits
