notes.title: 0.2.12 PATCH WITH GAMEPLAY AND BALANCE UPDATE ARRIVED
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Today’s update is worth getting excited over! After all, we considerably improved the balance, tuned the optimization and fixed certain gameplay issues. 

With that off our hands, we can finally return to working on the following patch - a big update with some brand new content. We hope it won’t take long and just within a few weeks you’ll have many new things to enjoy in Fishing Planet!

But that’s coming a bit later, and now we’ll tell you about the current patch:

First off, to add dynamics and challenge to the fishing process we put more power into the fish fights, letting you feel the thrill of a predator’s desperate struggle for life and freedom.

California and Florida, as well as all associated tackle and licenses are now accessible to players on earlier levels. Along with more experience for catching Common Fish, Uniques added and more intense fish fights we battle the grind and add more fun.

More Gold, really more - You get more gold for reaching higher levels and you get even more gold for earning the third stages of Achievements.

Fish population distribution changed on all waterway along with slight tuning of lure attractivity for different fish species. You'll need additional time to hunt em all down.
Please, note that Florida and California fish population distribution is subject to further tuning. You will be able to enjoy fishing there to the fullest in the following update.

Trophy Perch has been modified and now looks different from a Common Perch. Who will be the first to post a screenshot?;)

Introducing considerable optimization to the 32-bit version and an experimental Fishing Planet build for Mac. The game is running really faster now. We did a lot to optimize the game’s overall performance and reduce possible crashes. 

And, the last but not the least - a lot of options added to the settings menu. Yeah, invert mouse folk - rejoice!

Have fun fishing! Let us know what you think!:)

P.S.
All testers get a Week-long Premium for all of their help!

Here are the patch notes!

Gameplay:

Fish AI tuning (Fish AI tuning to intensify the fish fights and add the skill value to it (tackle tuned, fish AI tuned to ensure maximum fun)
Distribution of fish population on waterways tuned and changed, some species migrated to different areas on the lakes and rivers (this includes uniques being present at all lakes and rivers).
Experience reward overhaul throughout all fish diversity, game progress streamlined
Florida and California now available earlier – Everglades lvl 16 and San Joaquin lvl 18
Licenses pricing changed 
Home State relocation pricing changed
Travelling balance changed with the consideration of players current Home State
Achievements tuned and rewards changed


Features:

Fishnet capacity status now on HUD (Right under the weather conditions data)
Feedback on reel and hands when you reel in (You start reeling in slower when there's weight or fish fighting on the other end).
Trophy Yellow Perch body form added
Anti-cheat system enabled and tuned
Permanent breakdown of items introduced
Outfit damage system tuned and fixed


Physics:

Tackle physical behavior tuning and fix
Tackle physics performance optimization


Bug fixing:

Tutorial fish biting issues fixed
Chat ban fixing (players get unbanned automatically when the penalty terms ends)
Licenses fines fix (Fines are charged immediately) 
Duration of licenses bug fixed (licenses shall last a day more)
Connectivity issues significantly reduced
Inventory fixes and performance optimization
 No need to unplug your controllers anymore!


Options added to settings menu:

Environment sound volume controls added to settings (birds, rain, etc.)
VSync added to settings menu
Mouse inversion option added to settings menu
Mouse sensitivity option added to settings menu


Optimization:

Loading time dramatically reduced
Overall FPS increased at about 10+%
Fastest graphics setting is toggled automatically for low end PCs
Scenes, fish models and shaders have been heavily optimized
Fog effects tuning and optimization


Art add-ons:

Splashes diversified
Water ripples intensified


Crashes and stability:

Win 32 bit version stability significantly enhanced
Win 64 bit with 4gb RAM or less stability increased
Warning message added for users with low memory


DLC and Premium changes:

360 premium now accumulates all licenses
Crappie and Catfish DLC licenses duration increased to 7 days
Bass Fighter Pack and Trout Pioneer Pack licenses duration increased to 30 days


Other platform support

Mac platform support added and in test
